jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in C++ or Python programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Deep understanding of machine learning principles to ensure algorithms perform within strict power limits.

• Maintaining a current and thorough understanding of the latest developments in Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP), and system-on-chip (SoC) architectures to effectively leverage hardware-specific features for maximum efficiency and thermal management.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to ensure feature performance remains consistent across all use cases. You will work at the intersection of ML and system architecture, technical specialists will define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware. You will optimize the end-to-end performance of ML models to ensure compliance with strict power and thermal constraints, as the scope of the role encompasses leveraging specialized expertise in Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) and Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architectures to accelerate machine learning models while maintaining system stability and device performance standards.The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first-party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.
 Responsibilities

• Utilise Digital Signal Processors (DSP) and Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) architectures to accelerate ML models while effectively minimizing thermal impact.

• Conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to maintain consistent feature performance across all use cases.

• Own the end-to-end performance optimization of models to operate within a strict power budget.

• Define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware at the intersection of ML and system architecture.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in linguaggi di programmazione C++ o Python, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato.

• 1 anno di esperienza con l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione del modello, valutazione del modello, elaborazione dei dati, debugging).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

• Profonda comprensione dei principi di machine learning per garantire gli algoritmi eseguire entro limiti di potenza rigorosi.

• Mantenere una comprensione corrente e approfondita degli ultimi sviluppi nelle architetture Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP), e system-on-chip (SoC) per sfruttare efficacemente le caratteristiche hardware-specifiche per la massima efficienza e la gestione termica.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

In questo ruolo, effettuerai una rigorosa profilazione di potenza e implementerai ottimizzazioni specifiche hardware per garantire che le prestazioni della funzionalità rimangano costanti in tutti i casi di utilizzo. Potrai lavorare all'incrocio tra ML e architettura di sistema, specialisti tecnici definiranno gli standard di efficienza sull'hardware di nuova generazione. Ottimizzare le prestazioni end-to-end dei modelli ML per garantire il rispetto di rigidi vincoli di potenza e termici, in quanto il campo di applicazione del ruolo comprende sfruttando competenze specialistiche in Exagon Tensor Processors (HTP) e Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architetture per accelerare i modelli di machine learning pur mantenendo standard di stabilità del sistema e prestazioni del dispositivo. Il team di Piattaforme e Dispositivi comprende le varie piattaforme software di elaborazione di Google in ambienti (desktop, mobile, applicazioni), così come i nostri dispositivi e servizi di prima parte che combinano il meglio di Google AI, software e hardware. Squadre in questa area di ricerca, progettazione e sviluppo di nuove tecnologie per rendere l'interazione del nostro utente con l'informatica più veloce e senza soluzione di continuità, costruendo esperienze innovative per i nostri utenti in tutto il mondo.
responsabilità

• Utilizzare Digital Signal Processors (DSP) e Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) architetture per accelerare i modelli ML minimizzando efficacemente l'impatto termico.

• Condurre rigorosi profili di potenza e implementare ottimizzazioni specifiche hardware per mantenere le prestazioni di funzionalità costanti in tutti i casi di utilizzo.

• Proprio l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni end-to-end dei modelli per operare all'interno di un rigoroso budget di potenza.

• Definire gli standard di efficienza sull'hardware di prossima generazione all'incrocio tra ML e architettura di sistema.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in C++- oder Python-Programmiersprachen oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss.

• 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit ML-Infrastruktur (z. B. Modellbereitstellung, Modellbewertung, Datenverarbeitung, Debugging).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereichen.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien.

• Tiefes Verständnis der Prinzipien des maschinellen Lernens, um sicherzustellen, dass Algorithmen innerhalb strenger Leistungsgrenzen funktionieren.

• Aufrechterhaltung eines aktuellen und gründlichen Verständnisses der neuesten Entwicklungen in Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) und System-on-Chip-Architekturen, um hardwarespezifische Funktionen für maximale Effizienz und Wärmemanagement effektiv zu nutzen.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle führen Sie ein strenges Power-Profiling durch und implementieren hardwarespezifische Optimierungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Feature-Performance in allen Anwendungsfällen konsistent bleibt. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von ML und Systemarchitektur, technische Spezialisten definieren die Effizienzstandards für Next-Generation-Hardware. Sie optimieren die End-to-End-Performance von ML-Modellen, um die Einhaltung strenger Leistungs- und Wärmeanforderungen sicherzustellen, da der Umfang der Rolle die Nutzung von spezialisiertem Fachwissen in Hexagon Tensor-Prozessoren (HTP) und Digital Signal Processors (DSP)-Architekturen umfasst, um maschinelle Lernmodelle zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig Systemstabilität und Geräteleistungsstandards beizubehalten. Das Platforms and Devices-Team umfasst die verschiedenen Computing-Software-Plattformen von Google in allen Umgebungen (Desktop, Mobile, Anwendungen) sowie unsere First-Party-Geräte und -Dienste, die das Beste aus Google AI, Software und Hardware kombinieren. Teams in diesem Bereich erforschen, entwerfen und entwickeln neue Technologien, um die Interaktion unserer Benutzer mit dem Computing schneller und nahtloser zu gestalten und innovative Erlebnisse für unsere Benutzer auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Verwenden Sie Digital Signal Processors (DSP) und Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP), um ML-Modelle zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig die thermische Belastung effektiv zu minimieren.

• Führen Sie ein strenges Power-Profiling durch und implementieren Sie hardwarespezifische Optimierungen, um eine konsistente Feature-Performance in allen Anwendungsfällen zu gewährleisten.

• Besitzen Sie die End-to-End-Leistungsoptimierung von Modellen, um innerhalb eines strengen Energiebudgets zu arbeiten.

• Definieren Sie die Effizienzstandards für Hardware der nächsten Generation an der Schnittstelle von ML und Systemarchitektur.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel en langage de programmation C++ ou Python, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé.

• 1 an d'expérience de l'infrastructure ML (p. ex. déploiement de modèles, évaluation de modèles, traitement des données, débogage).

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaines techniques connexes.

• Expérience du développement de technologies accessibles.

• Compréhension approfondie des principes d'apprentissage automatique pour garantir que les algorithmes fonctionnent dans des limites de puissance strictes.

• Maintenir une compréhension actuelle et approfondie des derniers développements dans les processeurs de signal numérique (DSP), les processeurs de tension Hexagon (HTP) et les architectures système-sur-puce (SoC) afin d'exploiter efficacement des fonctionnalités spécifiques au matériel pour une efficacité maximale et une gestion thermique.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Dans ce rôle, vous effectuerez un profilage de puissance rigoureux et mettre en œuvre des optimisations spécifiques au matériel pour assurer que les performances de la fonctionnalité restent cohérentes dans tous les cas d'utilisation. Vous travaillerez à l'intersection de l'architecture ML et du système, les spécialistes techniques définiront les normes d'efficacité sur le matériel de prochaine génération. Vous optimiserez les performances de bout en bout des modèles ML afin d'assurer le respect des contraintes thermiques et de puissance strictes, car la portée du rôle consiste à tirer parti de l'expertise spécialisée en Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) et Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architectures pour accélérer les modèles d'apprentissage des machines tout en maintenant la stabilité du système et les normes de performance des appareils. L'équipe Plateformes et périphériques regroupe les différentes plateformes logicielles de Google à travers les environnements (desktop, mobile, applications), ainsi que nos périphériques et services de première partie qui combinent le meilleur de Google AI, logiciel et matériel. Des équipes dans ce domaine étudient, conçoivent et développent de nouvelles technologies pour rendre l'interaction de notre utilisateur avec l'informatique plus rapide et plus transparente, en créant des expériences innovantes pour nos utilisateurs dans le monde entier.
Responsabilités

• Utiliser des processeurs de signal numérique (DSP) et des processeurs de tension Hexagon (HTP) pour accélérer les modèles ML tout en minimisant efficacement l'impact thermique.

• Effectuez un profilage rigoureux de la puissance et implémentez des optimisations spécifiques au matériel afin de maintenir des performances cohérentes dans tous les cas d'utilisation.

• Posséder l'optimisation de performance de bout en bout des modèles pour fonctionner dans un budget de puissance strict.

• Définir les normes d'efficacité du matériel de nouvelle génération à l'intersection de l'architecture ML et du système.

titleByLocale.it: Data Science PhD Tirocinante, 2027

titleByLocale.de: Data Science PhD Praktikant, 2027
titleByLocale.fr: Data Science PhD Stagiaire, 2027

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Statistics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related technical field involving experimental design and quantitative analysis of experimental data, and in your penultimate year of study.

• Experience working with datasets using Python, R, SAS, MATLAB, or other statistical software.

• Experience with methods of statistical data analysis (e.g., linear models, hypothesis testing, multi-level models, Bayesian methods, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with causal inference methods.

• Experience developing intellectual capital such as peer-reviewed publications.

• Ability to complete a minimum 13 weeks internship in Switzerland starting between May-July 2027.

About the job
 Google's data scientists work within our Software Engineering organization, including Search, YouTube, and Google Ads. We analyze sets of data and continually run live experiments in order to help drive critical decisions at Google. Specifically, we support the development of innovative, highly scalable, next-generation technologies through research and advanced analysis.
 Google is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

• Provide research on topics including Google's business model and search techniques.

• Produce quantitative and qualitative modeling of business dynamics, user behavior, and more.

• Identify areas for further investigation as well as creating innovative methods of analysis.

Da Google Ads a Chrome, Android a YouTube, Social to Local, gli ingegneri di Google stanno cambiando il mondo un risultato tecnologico dopo un altro.

Les data scientists de Google travaillent au sein de notre organisation de génie logiciel, y compris Search, YouTube et Google Ads. Nous analysons des ensembles de données et faisons continuellement des expériences en direct afin d'aider à conduire des décisions critiques chez Google. • 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience with caffolding, Pod, and Flume.

• Experience debugging bottlenecks using profiling toolsand optimizing performance.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python or C++).

• 2 years of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

• 1 year of experience with AI/ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, model optimization, data processing, or debugging).

• Experience developing and deploying multilingual natural language processing models.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.

• Expertise in debugging Agent logic (ReAct loops, Chain of Thought) and optimizing tool selection.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.

• Experience connecting agents to enterprise knowledge bases and optimizing RAG chunking to prevent hallucinations.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI, you are the "Agent Engineer" and the primary delivery arm for our customers' most critical AI initiatives. You will take initial conversational prototypes and transform them into production-ready solutions, owning the end-to-end engineering life-cycle.
The Cloud Applied AI (AAI) powers business growth with Gemini Enterprise. Our portfolio includes Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (Shopping Agent, CX Agent Studio, Agent Assist, Vertex AI Search - Commerce, Customer Experience Insights), along with other vertical and domain packaged solutions. We enable high adoption and speed to value by building solutions that are quickly deployed, delivering new 0-to-1 capabilities with startup agility. Team members operate at the forefront of AI, collaborating directly with model builders with unprecedented speed. Join us to work on cutting-edge projects and shape the future of AI in a fast-paced, collaborative, and impactful environment.
 Responsibilities

• Serve as the delivery lead for conversational AI pilots, taking initial proof-of-value code and refactoring it for production by replacing stubs with secure, real-world integrations.

• Own the delivery of the initial Customer User Journeys (CUJs), ensuring that conversational flows are not just functional, but optimized for (top customer/industry priorities).

• Architect and optimize complex agentic workloads, focusing on reasoning loops, tool selection, and reducing latency while maintaining production-grade security and networking.

• Implement critical infrastructure, including rate limiting, error management, and regional failover strategies; develop monitoring systems and alerting dashboards during "Go-Live" windows to ensure stability as traffic scales.

• Architect security perimeters (VPC, IAM, CMEK) to satisfy CISO requirements and optimize RAG strategies to balance latency, accuracy, and cost.

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik, KI, Machine Learning oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• Expertise im Debugging von Agent-Logik (ReAct-Loops, Chain of Thought) und der Optimierung der Werkzeugauswahl.

• Erleben Sie die Implementierung von Multiagentensystemen mit Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, CrewAI oder Googles Agent Development Kit (ADK)) und komplexen Mustern wie ReAct, Selbstreflexion und hierarchische Delegation.

• Erleben Sie die Verbindung von Agenten mit Unternehmenswissensdatenbanken und die Optimierung von RAG-Chunking, um Halluzinationen zu verhindern.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern Informationen miteinander verbinden, erforschen und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Rechnen, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.
Als Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI sind Sie der "Agent Engineer" und der primäre Lieferarm für die wichtigsten KI-Initiativen unserer Kunden. Sie nehmen erste Gesprächsprototypen und verwandeln sie in produktionsfähige Lösungen, die den End-to-End-Engineering-Lebenszyklus besitzen.
Die Cloud Applied AI (AAI) unterstützt das Geschäftswachstum mit Gemini Enterprise. Unser Portfolio umfasst Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (Shopping Agent, CX Agent Studio, Agent Assist, Vertex AI Search - Commerce, Customer Experience Insights) sowie andere vertikale und domänenverpackte Lösungen. Wir ermöglichen eine hohe Akzeptanz und Schnelligkeit, indem wir Lösungen entwickeln, die schnell eingesetzt werden und neue 0-zu-1-Fähigkeiten mit Startup-Agilität liefern. Die Teammitglieder arbeiten an der Spitze der KI und arbeiten direkt mit Modellbauern mit beispielloser Geschwindigkeit zusammen. Arbeiten Sie mit uns an innovativen Projekten und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der KI in einem schnelllebigen, kollaborativen und wirkungsvollen Umfeld.
Zuständigkeiten

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C++, Java, Go).

• Experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (e.g., language modeling, computer vision).

• Experience with data structures and algorithms.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

• Experience with AI development, agentic workflows, and applying machine learning concepts to real-world applications.

• Hands-on experience building anti-abuse systems, fraud detection mechanisms, or security solutions, with a solid understanding of account security and identity concepts.

• Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying large-scale systems and high-throughput data processing pipelines using tools such as SQL or Flume.

• Excellent problem-solving and investigative skills.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The DeepMind Abuse Detection team, a key part of Core User Protection, works in close collaboration with DeepMind to pioneer account-centric detection technologies for the innovative Generative AI Safety Platform. As DeepMind rapidly expands its Generative AI offerings, our team was formed to address the critical need for dedicated defenses against product misuse, shifting from reactive measures to proactive, actor-focused prevention. Our mission is to ensure a friction-free experience for benign users, provide guidance for those who are confused, and implement proportionate actions for malicious actors. To achieve this, we leverage detection mechanisms including Large Language Model (LLM) raters, clustering techniques, transformer-based models, and account intelligence signals.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
 Responsibilities

• Contribute to the development and implementation of systems that detect and prevent abuse across DeepMind products.

• Design, build, and maintain components of our account-centric abuse detection systems on the GenAI Safety Platform.

• Analyze data to understand abuse patterns and improve the effectiveness of our detection methods and writing and testing production-quality code, and participating in code reviews.

• Work with partner teams (e.g., Trust and Safety, Product Managers) to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Titoli minimi

- Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. - 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. - 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad es., Python, C++, Java, Go). - Esperienza con tecniche GenAI (ad es., LLM, Multi-Modal, Modelli di Visione Grande) o con concetti correlati a GenAI (ad es., modellazione del linguaggio, visione del computer). - Esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

Qualificazioni preferite

- Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o un campo tecnico correlato. - L'esperienza con lo sviluppo di AI, flussi di lavoro di Álva, e l'applicazione di concetti di apprendimento automatico per applicazioni reali. - L'esperienza pratica costruisce sistemi antiabuso, meccanismi di rilevamento delle frodi o soluzioni di sicurezza, con una solida comprensione dei concetti di sicurezza e identità degli account. - Proven record di progettazione, costruzione e distribuzione di sistemi su larga scala e condotti di elaborazione dati ad alta velocità utilizzando strumenti come SQL o Flume. - Eccellenti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e investigative.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre voi e il nostro business fast-paced crescono ed evolveranno. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership ed entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la stack mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il team DeepMind Abuse Detection, parte fondamentale della Core User Protection, lavora in stretta collaborazione con DeepMind per la pioniera delle tecnologie di rilevamento account-centric per l'innovativa piattaforma di sicurezza Generative AI. Poiché DeepMind amplia rapidamente le sue offerte Generative AI, il nostro team è stato formato per affrontare la necessità critica di difese dedicate contro l'uso improprio dei prodotti, passando da misure reattive a prevenzione proattiva e focalizzata sull'ator.

La nostra missione è quella di garantire un'esperienza senza attrito per gli utenti benigni, fornire orientamenti per coloro che sono confusi, e attuare azioni proporzionate per gli attori dannosi. A tal fine, utilizziamo meccanismi di rilevamento tra cui i rating Large Language Model (LLM), tecniche di clustering, modelli basati su trasformatori e segnali di intelligence degli account. Il team di base costruisce la base tecnica dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori degli elementi di progettazione sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppo, componenti dei prodotti e infrastrutture di Google.

Questi sono i punti di partenza essenziali per un'esperienza eccellente, sicura e coerente per i nostri utenti e per guidare il ritmo dell'innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere le barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come il team di Core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda.

Responsabilità

- Contribuire allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di sistemi che rilevano e impediscono abusi nei prodotti DeepMind. - Progettare, costruire e mantenere componenti dei nostri sistemi di rilevamento degli abusi sulla piattaforma di sicurezza GenAI. - Analizzare i dati per comprendere i modelli di abuso e migliorare l'efficacia dei nostri metodi di rilevamento e scrivere e testare codice di qualità della produzione, e partecipare a revisioni di codice. - Lavorare con i team partner (ad esempio, Trust and Safety, Product Manager) per comprendere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche.

Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées nouvelles de tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage des données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception de l'interface utilisateur et le mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets à mesure que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à bout de main alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

L'équipe de détection de l'abus de DeepMind, une partie essentielle de la protection de l'utilisateur de base, travaille en étroite collaboration avec DeepMind pour mettre en place des technologies de détection centrées sur les comptes pour la plateforme innovante de sécurité de l'IA.

Notre mission est d'assurer une expérience sans friction pour les utilisateurs bénins, de fournir des conseils à ceux qui sont confus, et de mettre en œuvre des actions proportionnées pour les acteurs malveillants. Pour ce faire, nous utilisons des mécanismes de détection, y compris les noteurs de Grand Langage (LLM), les techniques de regroupement, les modèles basés sur les transformations, et les signaux d'intelligence de compte.

Nous regardons les produits de Google pour construire des solutions centrales, éliminer les obstacles techniques et renforcer les systèmes existants. En tant qu'équipe de base, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influencer les décisions techniques importantes dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

Responsabilités

- Contribuer au développement et à la mise en oeuvre de systèmes qui détectent et préviennent les abus dans les produits DeepMind. - Concevoir, construire et maintenir des composants de nos systèmes de détection des abus centrés sur les comptes sur la plateforme de sécurité GenAI. - Analyser les données pour comprendre les modèles d'abus et améliorer l'efficacité de nos méthodes de détection et rédiger et tester des codes de qualité de production, et participer à des examens de codes. - Travailler avec les équipes partenaires (p. ex., Trust and Safety, Product Managers) pour comprendre les exigences et les traduire en solutions techniques.

Experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (e.g., language modeling, computer vision).
Experience with data structures and algorithms.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Cloud AI for Science, Full Stack

titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer III, Cloud AI for Science, Full Stack
titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere III, Cloud AI for Science, Full Stack
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur III, Cloud AI for Science, Full Stack
titleByLocale.fr: Software Ingénieur III, Cloud AI for Science, Full Stack

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

• 2 years of experience with developing Large Language Models.

• Experience with agentic coding workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google AI Science on Cloud is a collaboration between Cloud, DeepMind, Research, and Labs to accelerate scientific research and discovery by using advanced AI systems. Our goal is to establish Google as the essential platform for complex, high value problems in science, technology, and industry.
 Our team’s role is to bring DeepMind / Research solutions to Cloud customers as mature products that are directly driving acceleration.
 The team is responsible for the quality of our products, and works closely with customers to close feature and quality gaps they face in their various applications. The agentic coding revolution that has hit software engineering is quickly spreading to the world’s most valuable knowledge workloads - and we are working to directly shape this transformation.
 The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Responsibilities

• Contribute to launching science agents such as Co-Scientist, AlphaEvolve, and other upcoming products for the scientific research community.

• Build scalable and flexible infrastructure to deliver smooth user experiences across our suite of products.

• Iterate on the quality of agents and tools so that they fulfill customers needs.

• Work with the various research teams involved, to drive future development and ensure a healthy feedback loop.

• Develop self-serve tools so that research teams can bring their own agents and UI components.

titleByLocale.it: Leader, Pagamenti (inglese, francese) (Contratto a termine)
titleByLocale.en: Strategic Partner Development Lead, Payments (English, French) (Fixed-term contract)
titleByLocale.de: Strategic Partner Development Lead, Payments (Englisch, Französisch) (Festvertrag)
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du développement des partenaires stratégiques, Paiements (anglais, français) (contrat à durée déterminée)

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of experience in business development, partnerships, management consulting, in the payments, e-commerce/retail, technology industries on EMEA market.

• Experience in signing and negotiating agreements, business development, partner management, or product management in an internet or technology environment.

• Experience working with C-level executives and cross-functionally across all levels of management.

• Ability to communicate in English and French fluently as this is a customer-facing role that requires interactions with local and international stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or other advanced degree.

• Experience managing complex, end-to-end partnerships.

• Experience working autonomously in a dynamic, ever-changing, and collaborative environment.

• Ability to identify potential business opportunities, assess financial/business benefit, structure agreements, and discuss terms with strategic partners.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills.

About the job
 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

Google is investing significantly in building a world-leading payments platform, underpinned by strong, lasting ecosystem partnerships. From enabling mobile payments to reducing mobile checkout friction, to digitizing transit in major cities; the Payments Partnerships team works closely with Product and top partners to develop engaging commerce experiences globally. Google navigates the intersection of complex industries (e.g., financial services, retail). Managing successful relationships in this ecosystem requires the entire organization to be strategically aligned. To that end, the Payments Partnership team will help lead, manage, and grow these strategic partnerships. Google needs experienced leaders to help further its business and relationships in financial services and payments. The work spans many products, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders in Google's Product Development, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Marketing and Legal organisations.
 In this role, you will focus on technical setup, launch finalization, and senior-level contract negotiation with Île-de-France Mobilités (IDFM/Paris Metro), post-launch coordination, and optimizing key financial institutions and online merchants.
 The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

Responsibilities

• Own and drive the final, highly complex contract negotiations and signature process with one of the top transit partners in France, aiming for a successful contract closing.

• Coordinate post-launch activities cross-functionally with Marketing and PR teams to define and execute the launch communication plan, ensuring a seamless rollout.

• Act as the strategic lead for the IDFM initiative through its final lifecycle phases, managing risk and aligning internal and external stakeholders to meet strict project timelines.

• Partner with the rest of the BD team to support high-stakes negotiations, deepen senior bank relationships, and drive card portfolio launches on Google Wallet.

• Partner with the rest of the BD team to manage key Google Pay Online API accounts (focusing on flagship Transit partners) and execute commercial campaigns to accelerate adoption and transaction volume.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 7 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, partnership, consulenza manageriale, nei pagamenti, e-commerce/retail, industrie tecnologiche sul mercato EMEA.

• Esperienza nella firma e negoziazione di accordi, sviluppo aziendale, gestione dei partner, o gestione dei prodotti in un ambiente Internet o tecnologico.

• Esperienza di lavoro con dirigenti a livello C e cross-funzionale su tutti i livelli di gestione.

• Capacità di comunicare in inglese e francese in modo fluido in quanto questo è un ruolo di customer-facing che richiede interazioni con gli stakeholder locali e internazionali.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o altro grado avanzato.

• Esperienza di gestione di partnership complesse e end-to-end.

• Esperienza di lavoro autonomamente in un ambiente dinamico, in continua evoluzione e collaborativo.

• Capacità di identificare potenziali opportunità di business, valutare le indennità finanziarie/commerciali, accordi di struttura e discutere i termini con partner strategici.

• Ottima comunicazione e capacità di influenza.

Riguardo al lavoro
La linea di prodotti e servizi di Google per i nostri clienti non smette mai di crescere. Il team di Partnerships Development è responsabile della ricerca e dell'esplorazione di nuove opportunità con i partner di Google. Equipaggiato con il tuo business acum e la vasta conoscenza del prodotto, sei proprio sulla linea anteriore di interagire con i nostri partner, e aiutarli a trovare modi per crescere utilizzando le nuove offerte di prodotto di Google. La vostra conoscenza di verticali e relazioni rilevanti con i principali operatori del settore contribuirà a modellare le nostre grandi applicazioni e contenuti per prodotti come YouTube, Google TV e Commercio.

Google sta investendo in modo significativo nella costruzione di una piattaforma di pagamento leader mondiale, sostenuta da partnership ecosistemiche forti e durature. Da consentire ai pagamenti mobili di ridurre l'attrito di checkout mobile, di digitalizzare il transito nelle principali città; il team Payments Partnerships lavora a stretto contatto con il prodotto e i migliori partner per sviluppare esperienze di commercio coinvolgenti a livello globale. Google naviga l'intersezione di industrie complesse (ad esempio, servizi finanziari, vendita al dettaglio). Gestire relazioni di successo in questo ecosistema richiede che l'intera organizzazione sia strategicamente allineata. A tal fine, il team di Payments Partnership aiuterà a guidare, gestire e far crescere queste partnership strategiche. Google ha bisogno di leader esperti per aiutare ulteriormente il suo business e le relazioni nei servizi finanziari e pagamenti. Il lavoro si estende su molti prodotti, collaborando con le parti interessate interfunzionali nello sviluppo del prodotto di Google, Ingegneria, Go-to-Market, Marketing e organizzazioni legali.
In questo ruolo, ti concentrerai sull'impostazione tecnica, sulla finalizzazione del lancio e sulla negoziazione dei contratti di alto livello con Île-de-France Mobilités (IDFM/Paris Metro), sul coordinamento post-lancio e sull'ottimizzazione delle principali istituzioni finanziarie e dei commercianti online.
L'organizzazione Global Partnerships è responsabile dell'esplorazione di nuove opportunità con i partner di Google. Il team di Google Global Partnerships lavora con una vasta gamma di partner per portare il meglio di Google per alimentare il loro business. Il team di Global Partnerships supporta i propri team di prodotto di Google con partnership essenziali per aiutare le esperienze utente di Google nella pubblicità, Ricerca, Assistente, Mappe, Viaggi, Shopping, Pagamenti e altro ancora. I team creano partnership, strategie di go-to-market e crescita aziendale incubata per una varietà di prodotti.

responsabilità

• Possedere e guidare i negoziati contrattuali conclusivi e altamente complessi e il processo di firma con uno dei principali partner di transito in Francia, mirando a una chiusura del contratto di successo.

• Coordinare le attività post-lancio cross-functionally con i team Marketing e PR per definire ed eseguire il piano di comunicazione di lancio, garantendo un rollout senza interruzioni.

• Agire come il piombo strategico per l'iniziativa IDFM attraverso le sue fasi finali del ciclo di vita, gestire il rischio e allineare gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per soddisfare le severe tempistiche del progetto.

• Partner con il resto del team BD per sostenere le trattative di alto livello, approfondire le relazioni bancarie senior e portare il portafoglio di carte lancia su Google Wallet.

• Partner con il resto del team BD per gestire i principali account API online di Google Pay (concentrandosi sui partner Transit) ed eseguire campagne commerciali per accelerare l'adozione e il volume delle transazioni.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.

• 2 years of experience in Data Science, Applied AI, or similar technical roles.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience or familiarity with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.

• Experience in deriving actionable insights, root causes, and intelligence from complex data sources across cybersecurity or anti-fraud, protecting users against cyber threats, and using AI to automate complex processes or operations

• Ability to understand complex engineering systems and processes.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.

• Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail and focus on getting things done.

About the job
 Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

You will join a team of engineering analysts dedicated to protecting Google accounts and products from emerging threats. In this role, you will be at the cross-roads of cyber-security and AI, designing and implementing machine learning models and AI-powered agents to solve some of our most critical business challenges.

You will play a key part in a fast-paced environment where you will have the chance to apply your analytical and technical skills to complex problems at a global scale. This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to learn, innovate, and make a real impact.
At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.
 Responsibilities

• Build a new AI-based capability leveraging our Transformers-based detection system to evolve and automate Incident Response, while generating threat intelligence that is relevant to protect Google accounts.

• Transform, automate and scale up our team processes by developing AI Agents.Automate a large fraction of our operational workload, like alert generation and incident analysis, using techniques derived from ML, LLMs, operations research.

• Apply our threat intelligence to be ready to respond to new adversarial campaigns.

• Manage the response to incidents targeting Google Accounts, including the special response in case of severe incidents in collaboration with other partner teams.

• Work with our Operations team to scale the operational work required to protect Google accounts, e.g, managing low severity escalations and alerts, and maintaining the ground truth quality. Provide the training and work to get tooling improvements when needed.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica, o equivalente esperienza pratica.

• 2 anni di esperienza nell'analisi dei dati, tra cui l'individuazione delle tendenze, la generazione di statistiche di sintesi, e il disegno di informazioni da dati quantitativi e qualitativi.

• 2 anni di esperienza in Data Science, Applied AI, o ruoli tecnici simili.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• 2 anni di esperienza o familiarità con una o più delle seguenti lingue: SQL, R, Python o C++.

• Esperienza nella derivazione di intuizioni attuabili, cause della radice e intelligenza da fonti di dati complesse attraverso la sicurezza informatica o antifrode, proteggendo gli utenti dalle minacce informatiche, e utilizzando AI per automatizzare processi o operazioni complesse

• Capacità di comprendere sistemi e processi di ingegneria complessi.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione e la capacità di influenzare trasversalmente a vari livelli.

• Eccellente problem-solving e capacità di pensiero critico con attenzione ai dettagli e concentrarsi sul fare le cose.

Riguardo al lavoro
I membri del team Trust & Safety hanno il compito di identificare e affrontare i maggiori problemi che sfidano la sicurezza e l'integrità dei nostri prodotti. Essi utilizzano il know-how tecnico, le eccellenti capacità di problem solving, le intuizioni degli utenti e la comunicazione proattiva per proteggere gli utenti e i nostri partner da abusi attraverso i prodotti Google come ricerca, mappe, Gmail e Google Ads. In questa squadra, sei un grande pensatore e un giocatore di squadra strategico con la passione per fare ciò che è giusto. Lavori a livello globale e interfunzionale con gli ingegneri di Google e i product manager per identificare e combattere i casi di abuso e frode a velocità di Google - con urgenza. E si orgogliosa di sapere che ogni giorno si sta lavorando duro per promuovere la fiducia in Google e garantire i più alti livelli di sicurezza degli utenti.

Ti unirai a un team di analisti ingegneristici dedicati alla protezione di account e prodotti Google dalle minacce emergenti. In questo ruolo, sarete al crocevia della sicurezza informatica e dell'IA, progettando e implementando modelli di machine learning e agenti alimentati dall'IA per risolvere alcune delle nostre sfide aziendali più critiche.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave in un ambiente veloce dove si avrà la possibilità di applicare le vostre abilità analitiche e tecniche a problemi complessi a livello globale. Questo è più che un lavoro; è un'opportunità per imparare, innovare e fare un impatto reale.
A Google lavoriamo duramente per guadagnare la fiducia dei nostri utenti ogni giorno. Trust & Safety è il team di Google di lotta contro gli abusi e gli esperti di fiducia degli utenti che lavorano quotidianamente per rendere Internet un posto più sicuro. Collaboriamo con i team di Google per fornire soluzioni audaci in aree di abuso come malware, spam e dirottamento account. Un team di analisti, specialisti delle politiche, ingegneri e manager del programma, lavoriamo per ridurre il rischio e combattere gli abusi in tutti i prodotti di Google, proteggendo i nostri utenti, inserzionisti e editori in oltre 40 lingue.
responsabilità

• Costruire una nuova capacità basata su AI sfruttando il nostro sistema di rilevamento basato sui trasformatori per evolvere e automatizzare la risposta incidente, generando l'intelligenza delle minacce che è rilevante per proteggere gli account di Google.

• Trasformare, automatizzare e scalare i nostri processi di squadra sviluppando agenti AI. Automatizzare una grande frazione del nostro carico di lavoro operativo, come la generazione di allerta e l'analisi degli incidenti, utilizzando tecniche derivate da ML, LLM, ricerca operativa.

• Applicare la nostra intelligenza delle minacce per essere pronti a rispondere a nuove campagne avversarie.

• Gestire la risposta agli incidenti che mirano a account Google, inclusa la risposta speciale in caso di gravi incidenti in collaborazione con altri team partner.

• Lavorare con il nostro team Operazioni per scalare il lavoro operativo necessario per proteggere gli account Google, ad esempio, la gestione di escalation e avvisi di bassa gravità, e mantenere la qualità della verità di terra. Fornire la formazione e il lavoro per ottenere miglioramenti di utensili quando necessario.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Engineering-Systeme und Prozesse zu verstehen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, auf verschiedenen Ebenen funktionsübergreifend zu beeinflussen.

• Ausgezeichnete Problemlösungs- und kritische Denkfähigkeiten mit Liebe zum Detail und Fokus auf die Erledigung von Dingen.

Über den Job
Die Mitglieder des Trust & Safety-Teams haben die Aufgabe, die größten Probleme zu identifizieren und anzunehmen, die die Sicherheit und Integrität unserer Produkte in Frage stellen. Sie nutzen technisches Know-how, hervorragende Problemlösungskompetenzen, Benutzereinblicke und proaktive Kommunikation, um Benutzer und unsere Partner vor Missbrauch in Google-Produkten wie Search, Maps, Gmail und Google Ads zu schützen. In diesem Team bist du ein Big-Picture-Denker und strategischer Teamplayer mit einer Leidenschaft dafür, das Richtige zu tun. Sie arbeiten global und funktionsübergreifend mit Google-Ingenieuren und Produktmanagern zusammen, um Missbrauchs- und Betrugsfälle mit Google-Geschwindigkeit zu identifizieren und zu bekämpfen – und das mit großer Dringlichkeit. Und Sie sind stolz darauf, zu wissen, dass Sie jeden Tag hart daran arbeiten, das Vertrauen in Google zu fördern und ein Höchstmaß an Benutzersicherheit zu gewährleisten.

Sie werden einem Team von Engineering-Analysten beitreten, das sich dem Schutz von Google-Konten und -Produkten vor neuen Bedrohungen widmet. In dieser Rolle sind Sie an der Kreuzung von Cybersicherheit und KI und entwerfen und implementieren maschinelle Lernmodelle und KI-gestützte Agenten, um einige unserer wichtigsten geschäftlichen Herausforderungen zu lösen.

Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld spielen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre analytischen und technischen Fähigkeiten auf komplexe Probleme auf globaler Ebene anzuwenden. Dies ist mehr als nur ein Job; Es ist eine Gelegenheit zu lernen, zu innovieren und eine echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Trust & Safety ist das Team von Missbrauchsbekämpfungs- und Vertrauensexperten von Google, das täglich daran arbeitet, das Internet sicherer zu machen. Wir arbeiten mit Teams in ganz Google zusammen, um mutige Lösungen in Missbrauchsbereichen wie Malware, Spam und Account-Hijacking zu liefern. Als Team von Analysten, Policy-Spezialisten, Ingenieuren und Programmmanagern arbeiten wir daran, Risiken zu reduzieren und Missbrauch in allen Google-Produkten zu bekämpfen und unsere Nutzer, Werbetreibenden und Publisher auf der ganzen Welt in über 40 Sprachen zu schützen.

• Erstellen Sie eine neue KI-basierte Funktion, die unser Transformers-basiertes Erkennungssystem nutzt, um Incident Response zu entwickeln und zu automatisieren und gleichzeitig Bedrohungsinformationen zu generieren, die für den Schutz von Google-Konten relevant sind.

• Transformieren, automatisieren und skalieren Sie unsere Teamprozesse durch die Entwicklung von KI-Agenten. Automatisieren Sie einen großen Teil unserer betrieblichen Arbeitsbelastung, wie Alarmgenerierung und Vorfallsanalyse, mithilfe von Techniken, die aus ML, LLMs und Operations Research abgeleitet werden.

• Wenden Sie unsere Threat Intelligence an, um bereit zu sein, auf neue gegnerische Kampagnen zu reagieren.

• Verwalten Sie die Reaktion auf Vorfälle, die auf Google-Konten abzielen, einschließlich der speziellen Reaktion bei schweren Vorfällen in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Partnerteams.

• Arbeiten Sie mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, um die für den Schutz von Google-Konten erforderlichen operativen Arbeiten zu skalieren, z. B. die Verwaltung von Eskalationen und Warnungen mit geringem Schweregrad und die Aufrechterhaltung der Ground Truth-Qualität. Geben Sie das Training und die Arbeit, um bei Bedarf Werkzeugverbesserungen zu erhalten.

• 2 années d'expérience dans l'analyse des données, y compris l'identification des tendances, la production de statistiques sommaires et la collecte de données quantitatives et qualitatives.

• 2 ans d'expérience dans les sciences des données, l'IA appliquée ou des rôles techniques similaires.

Titres préférés:

• 2 ans d'expérience ou de familiarité avec une ou plusieurs des langues suivantes : SQL, R, Python ou C++.

• Expérience dans l'obtention de renseignements, de causes profondes et de sources de données complexes à travers la cybersécurité ou la lutte contre la fraude, la protection des utilisateurs contre les cybermenaces et l'utilisation de l'IA pour automatiser des processus ou des opérations complexes

• Capacité de comprendre les systèmes et les processus d'ingénierie complexes.

• Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation et capacité d'influencer les différents niveaux.

• Excellente capacité de résolution de problèmes et de pensée critique avec une attention aux détails et de se concentrer sur faire les choses.

Sur le travail
Les membres de l'équipe Trust & Safety sont chargés d'identifier et d'aborder les plus grands problèmes qui remettent en question la sécurité et l'intégrité de nos produits. Ils utilisent le savoir-faire technique, d'excellentes compétences de résolution de problèmes, des idées d'utilisateurs et une communication proactive pour protéger les utilisateurs et nos partenaires contre les abus dans les produits Google tels que Search, Maps, Gmail et Google Ads. Dans cette équipe, vous êtes un grand penseur de la photo et joueur d'équipe stratégique avec une passion pour faire ce qui est bien. Vous travaillez à l'échelle mondiale et interfonctionnelle avec les ingénieurs de Google et les gestionnaires de produits pour identifier et combattre les cas d'abus et de fraude à la vitesse de Google - avec urgence. Et vous êtes fier de savoir que chaque jour vous travaillez dur pour promouvoir la confiance dans Google et assurer les plus hauts niveaux de sécurité des utilisateurs.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'analystes d'ingénierie dédiée à la protection des comptes Google et des produits contre les menaces émergentes. Dans ce rôle, vous serez à la croisée des chemins de la cybersécurité et de l'IA, la conception et la mise en œuvre de modèles d'apprentissage automatique et d'agents alimentés par l'IA pour résoudre certains de nos défis commerciaux les plus critiques.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans un environnement rapide où vous aurez la chance d'appliquer vos compétences analytiques et techniques à des problèmes complexes à l'échelle mondiale. C'est plus qu'un simple travail, c'est une occasion d'apprendre, d'innover et d'avoir un impact réel.
Chez Google, nous travaillons dur pour gagner la confiance de nos utilisateurs. Trust & Safety est l'équipe de Google de lutte contre les abus et les experts de confiance des utilisateurs travaillant quotidiennement pour faire d'Internet un endroit plus sûr. Nous nous associons avec des équipes de Google pour fournir des solutions audacieuses dans des domaines d'abus tels que les logiciels malveillants, les spams et le détournement de compte. Une équipe d'analystes, de spécialistes des politiques, d'ingénieurs et de gestionnaires de programmes, nous nous efforçons de réduire les risques et de lutter contre les abus dans tous les produits Google, en protégeant nos utilisateurs, nos annonceurs et nos éditeurs dans plus de 40 langues.
Responsabilités

• Construisez une nouvelle capacité basée sur l'intelligence artificielle en tirant parti de notre système de détection basé sur les transformateurs pour évoluer et automatiser la réponse aux incidents, tout en générant des renseignements de menace qui sont pertinents pour protéger les comptes Google.

• Transformer, automatiser et étendre nos processus d'équipe en développant des agents d'IA. Automatisez une grande partie de notre charge de travail opérationnelle, comme la génération d'alertes et l'analyse d'incidents, en utilisant des techniques dérivées de ML, LLM, recherche opérationnelle.

• Appliquez notre renseignement de menace pour être prêt à répondre aux nouvelles campagnes contradictoires.

• Gérer la réponse aux incidents ciblant Google Accounts, y compris la réponse spéciale en cas d'incidents graves en collaboration avec d'autres équipes partenaires.

• Collaborez avec notre équipe d'opérations pour évaluer le travail opérationnel nécessaire pour protéger les comptes Google, par exemple, gérer les escalades et les alertes de faible gravité, et maintenir la qualité de la vérité au sol. Fournir la formation et le travail pour obtenir des améliorations d'outils au besoin.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• Experience with state of the art GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Centerpiece provides the foundational ground truth on what content is truly essential on any webpage. By cleanly isolating Main Content from auxiliary clutter, Centerpiece enables Google's search ranking algorithms, generative AI features, and LLM pretraining pipelines to focus strictly on high-signal content.In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
 Responsibilities

• Launch new versions of Centerpiece by improving the (prompted) Professor model, applying our Computer Use Agent, and training better student models.

• Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency,)

• Improve the tooling and infra.

• Maintain or ablate other systems that provide similar data, re-directing the clients to Centerpiece.

• Implement GenAI solutions, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to data preparation, optimization, and performance enhancements.

• Esperienza con le tecniche dell'arte GenAI (ad esempio, LLM, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) o con i concetti legati al GenAI (modello di lingua, visione del computer).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati.

• 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Centerpiece fornisce la verità fondamentale sul terreno su ciò che il contenuto è veramente essenziale su qualsiasi pagina web. Isolando i contenuti principali dal cluster ausiliario, Centerpiece consente agli algoritmi di ricerca di Google, alle caratteristiche di AI generative e alle tubazioni pre-training LLM di concentrarsi rigorosamente sui contenuti di alto livello. In Google Search, stiamo rivisitando ciò che significa cercare informazioni – in qualsiasi modo e ovunque. Per farlo, abbiamo bisogno di risolvere complesse sfide ingegneristiche ed espandere la nostra infrastruttura, mantenendo un'esperienza universalmente accessibile e utile a cui le persone in tutto il mondo si affidano. Entrando nel team di ricerca, avrai l'opportunità di avere un impatto su miliardi di persone a livello globale.
responsabilità

• Avviare nuove versioni di Centerpiece migliorando il modello (prompted) Professor, applicando il nostro agente di uso del computer, e formando migliori modelli di studenti.

• Collaborare con colleghi e stakeholder attraverso recensioni di design e codice per garantire le migliori pratiche tra le tecnologie disponibili (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, controllo del codice, accuratezza, testabilità e efficienza,)

• Migliorare l'attrezzo e l'infra.

• Mantenere o asportare altri sistemi che forniscono dati simili, reindirizzando i client a Centerpiece.

• Implementare soluzioni GenAI, utilizzare l'infrastruttura ML e contribuire alla preparazione dei dati, ottimizzazione e miglioramenti delle prestazioni.
