Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss.

• 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit ML-Infrastruktur (z. B. Modellbereitstellung, Modellbewertung, Optimierung, Datenverarbeitung, Debugging).

• Erfahrung mit modernsten GenAI-Techniken (z. B. LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) oder mit GenAI-bezogenen Konzepten (Sprachmodellierung, Computer Vision).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereichen.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Centerpiece bietet die grundlegende Wahrheit darüber, welche Inhalte auf jeder Webseite wirklich wichtig sind. Durch die saubere Isolierung von Hauptinhalten von Hilfs-Clutter ermöglicht Centerpiece Googles Such-Ranking-Algorithmen, generativen KI-Funktionen und LLM-Vorschulungs-Pipelines, sich ausschließlich auf High-Signal-Inhalte zu konzentrieren. In der Google-Suche überdenken wir, was es bedeutet, nach Informationen zu suchen - auf jede Weise und überall. Um dies zu erreichen, müssen wir komplexe technische Herausforderungen lösen und unsere Infrastruktur erweitern, während wir eine allgemein zugängliche und nützliche Erfahrung beibehalten, auf die sich Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen. Wenn Sie dem Suchteam beitreten, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Einfluss auf Milliarden von Menschen weltweit zu nehmen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Starten Sie neue Versionen von Centerpiece, indem Sie das (aufgeforderte) Professorenmodell verbessern, unseren Computer Use Agent anwenden und bessere Schülermodelle trainieren.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Peers und Stakeholdern durch Design- und Code-Reviews, um Best Practices unter den verfügbaren Technologien sicherzustellen (z. B. Stilrichtlinien, Code-In-Prüfung, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz),

• Verbessern Sie die Werkzeuge und infra.

• Pflegen oder ablatieren Sie andere Systeme, die ähnliche Daten bereitstellen, und leiten Sie die Clients zu Centerpiece um.

• Implementieren Sie GenAI-Lösungen, nutzen Sie die ML-Infrastruktur und tragen Sie zur Datenaufbereitung, Optimierung und Leistungssteigerung bei.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé.

• 1 an d'expérience avec l'infrastructure ML (p. ex. déploiement de modèles, évaluation de modèles, optimisation, traitement des données, débogage).

• Expérience des techniques de pointe du GenAI (p. ex., LLM, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) ou des concepts liés au GenAI (modèle linguistique, vision informatique).

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaines techniques connexes.

• 2 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• Expérience du développement de technologies accessibles.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Centerpiece fournit la vérité fondamentale sur ce que le contenu est vraiment essentiel sur n'importe quelle page Web. En isolant proprement le contenu principal à partir d'un encombre auxiliaire, Centerpiece permet aux algorithmes de classement de recherche de Google, aux fonctionnalités d'IA génératives et aux pipelines de préformation LLM de se concentrer strictement sur le contenu à haut signal. Dans Google Search, nous réimaginons ce que cela signifie de rechercher des informations – de n'importe quelle façon et n'importe où. Pour ce faire, nous devons résoudre des problèmes complexes d'ingénierie et développer notre infrastructure, tout en maintenant une expérience universellement accessible et utile sur laquelle les gens du monde entier comptent. En rejoignant l'équipe de recherche, vous aurez l'occasion de faire un impact sur des milliards de personnes dans le monde.
Responsabilités

• Lancez de nouvelles versions de Centerpiece en améliorant le modèle de professeur (prompté), en appliquant notre agent d'utilisation des ordinateurs et en formant de meilleurs modèles étudiants.

• Collaborer avec les pairs et les intervenants au moyen d'examens de conception et de codes afin d'assurer les meilleures pratiques parmi les technologies disponibles (p. ex., lignes directrices sur le style, vérification du code, précision, testabilité et efficacité),

• Améliorer l'outillage et infra.

• Maintenir ou supprimer d'autres systèmes qui fournissent des données similaires, en réorientant les clients vers Centerpiece.

• Mettre en œuvre des solutions GenAI, utiliser l'infrastructure ML et contribuer à la préparation des données, à l'optimisation et à l'amélioration des performances.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

•

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.

• 8 years of experience with SystemVerilog, hardware design, automation, design verification test.

• 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• 3 years of experience with enterprise class hardware systems design.

• Experience with data center engineering, server, storage and networking products.

About the job
 At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

At DeepMind, you’ll have the opportunity to revolutionize AI by applying state-of-the-art AI to chip design. We develop research breakthroughs that impact all aspects of the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) process, to significantly reduce the time to market of Google’s products and services.
 Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
 We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and optimize software tools to improve the quality of generated RTL and accelerate the execution of hardware compilation and EDA tools.

• Profile, identify, and resolve performance bottlenecks in software tools to speed up optimization and synthesis cycles.

• Collaborate with hardware architects, compiler engineers, and ML researchers to bridge the gap between high-level representations and highly optimized RTL.

• Develop robust, scalable automation scripts and software libraries to streamline and speed up RTL generation and optimization workflows.

• Work with product engineering teams to bring the software tools we are developing to production quality.

A Google DeepMind la nostra missione è quella di costruire il primo agente di apprendimento generale del mondo. Centrale a questa missione è il complesso compito di misurare l'intelligenza dei nostri prototipi. In qualità di ingegnere software, lavorerai con gli agenti AI all'avanguardia sviluppati dal nostro eccezionale team di scienziati di ricerca di Machine Learning e Neuroscience. Le tue responsabilità includeranno tutto dalla creazione di sistemi per test di agente utilizzando giochi 2D e 3D per lo sviluppo di problemi di test all'interno dei simulatori di fisica. Si creerà la visualizzazione grafica dei risultati, costruire le classifiche degli agenti competitivi e testare nuovi algoritmi sui robot. Per avere successo in questo ruolo è necessario avere una solida base nell'ingegneria del software e godere di lavorare su una vasta gamma di problemi difficili all'interno di un team guidato dalla missione.

A DeepMind, avrete l'opportunità di rivoluzionare l'IA applicando l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia per il design dei chip. Sviluppiamo innovazioni di ricerca che influenzano tutti gli aspetti del processo di Electronic Design Automation (EDA), per ridurre significativamente il tempo di mercato dei prodotti e servizi di Google.

Utilizziamo le nostre tecnologie per un ampio beneficio pubblico e una scoperta scientifica, assicurando la sicurezza e l'etica sono sempre la nostra massima priorità.
Stiamo spingendo i confini attraverso più domini. I nostri team globali offrono diverse opportunità di apprendimento e percorsi di carriera diversificati per coloro che sono spinti a raggiungere risultati eccezionali attraverso lo sforzo collettivo.

responsabilità

• Profilo, identificare e risolvere i colli di bottiglia delle prestazioni negli strumenti software per accelerare i cicli di ottimizzazione e sintesi.

Bei Google DeepMind ist es unsere Mission, den weltweit ersten Universal Learning Agent zu entwickeln. Als Software Engineer arbeiten Sie mit hochmodernen KI-Agenten zusammen, die von unserem außergewöhnlichen Team aus Wissenschaftlern aus den Bereichen Machine Learning und Neurowissenschaften entwickelt wurden. Über den Job

Bei Google setzen wir unsere Nutzer an die erste Stelle. Die Welt verändert sich ständig, deshalb brauchen wir Produktmanager, die sich ständig anpassen und begeistert sind, an Produkten zu arbeiten, die jeden Tag Millionen Menschen betreffen.

In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend, um Produkte von der Konzeption bis zum Launch zu führen, indem Sie die technische und geschäftliche Welt miteinander verbinden.

Einer der vielen Gründe, warum Google konsequent innovative, weltweit wechselnde Produkte auf den Markt bringt, ist die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team im Produktmanagement. Unser Team arbeitet eng mit kreativen Ingenieuren, Designern, Vermarktern usw. zusammen, um Technologien zu entwickeln, die den Zugang zu den Informationen der Welt verbessern. Wir sind verantwortlich für die Produktführung während des gesamten Ausführungszyklus, wobei wir uns speziell auf die Analyse, Positionierung, Verpackung, Förderung und Anpassung unserer Lösungen an unsere Nutzer konzentrieren.

Das Team von Ads in AI Experiences ist für die Neuentwicklung von Search Ads für die AI-Ära (AI-Übersicht, AI-Modus) verantwortlich. Wir bauen den Tech-Stack, die User Experience und das Geschäftsmodell gleichzeitig auf. Unsere Aufgabe ist es sicherzustellen, dass die Search Experience sich mit AI entwickelt und neue Wege für Nutzer freisetzt, die durch nahtlose kommerzielle Erfahrungen mit Unternehmen zu entdecken und zu interagieren.

Google Ads hilft, das offene Internet mit der besten Technologie, die verbindet und schafft Wert für Menschen, Verlage, Werbetreibende und Google. Wir sind aus mehreren Teams, die Bau von Googles Werbe-Produkte einschließlich Suche, Anzeige, Einkaufen, Reisen und Video-Werbung, sowie Analysen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums

- Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente. - 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits ou un rôle technique connexe. - 2 ans d'expérience en prenant des produits techniques de la conception au lancement (p. ex., idée à l'exécution, bout à bout, 0 à 1, etc.). - Expérience en développement ou en lancement de produits ou de technologies au sein de l'intelligence artificielle ou de l'apprentissage automatique (IA/ML).

Titres de compétence privilégiés

- Maîtrise en technologie ou en commerce. - 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction ou un rôle d'affaires (p. ex. marketing stratégique, opérations commerciales, consultation). - 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de préparation et de prestation de présentations techniques à des cadres supérieurs. - 1 an d'expérience en leadership technique. - Expérience en utilisant les LLM de SoTA pour créer de nouvelles expériences de produits (p. ex., en incitant ou en faisant appel à des SFT avec Gemini pour créer des expériences visibles pour les utilisateurs). - Expérience en recherche à échelle réduite, en recommandation ou en annonces.

Sur le travail

Chez Google, nous mettons nos utilisateurs en premier. Le monde est toujours en train de changer, donc nous avons besoin de Gestionnaires de produits qui s'adaptent continuellement et sont excités de travailler sur des produits qui affectent des millions de personnes chaque jour.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez de façon interfonctionnelle pour guider les produits de la conception au lancement en reliant les mondes technique et commercial. Vous pouvez décomposer les problèmes complexes en étapes qui conduisent au développement de produits.

Google apporte constamment des produits innovants et changeants sur le marché en raison du travail collaboratif que nous faisons dans la gestion des produits. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs créatifs, des concepteurs, des marketeurs, etc. pour aider à concevoir et développer des technologies qui améliorent l'accès aux informations du monde. Nous sommes responsables de guider les produits tout au long du cycle d'exécution, en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse, le positionnement, l'emballage, la promotion et la adaptation de nos solutions à nos utilisateurs.

L'équipe Ads in AI Experiences est chargée de réinventer les annonces de recherche pour l'ère AI (Aperçu AI, Mode AI). Nous construisons simultanément la pile technologique, l'expérience utilisateur et le modèle d'entreprise. Notre mission est de faire en sorte que l'expérience de recherche évolue avec l'IA, nous débloquons de nouvelles façons pour les utilisateurs de découvrir et d'engager avec les entreprises par des expériences commerciales sans faille.

Google Ads aide à alimenter l'internet ouvert avec la meilleure technologie qui connecte et crée de la valeur pour les gens, les éditeurs, les annonceurs et Google. Nous sommes constitués de plusieurs équipes, la construction de produits publicitaires de Google, y compris la recherche, l'affichage, les achats, les voyages et la publicité vidéo, ainsi que l'analyse. Nos équipes créent des expériences de confiance entre les gens et les entreprises avec des annonces utiles.

Nous permettons également à Google de s'engager avec les clients à l'échelle.

La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences, l'expérience et les études ou la formation pertinentes liées au travail.

US: 163000 $ - 236000 $ (USD) + 15% de bonus + capitaux propres + avantages

En savoir plus sur les avantages chez Google.

Responsabilités

- Réinventer des annonces de nouvelles expériences d'IA, y compris le mode AI et les aperçus d'IA. - Expérimenter avec une grande variété de nouvelles expériences d'annonce et lancer des fonctionnalités réussies. - Naviguer des annonces de recherche par le biais du changement de plateforme d'IA en tirant parti de Gemini pour fournir une excellente valeur utilisateur et annonceur avec des annonces dans les expériences d'IA.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in product design or UX.

• 5 years of experience leading design projects and managing people or teams.

• 3 years of work experience working with executive leaders.

• Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.

About the job
 At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a UX Design Manager, you will drive this vision by defining product strategy, mitigating complexity, and conceptualizing ecosystem-level UX. You are a systems-level thinker and a fierce advocate for both your users and your team.

You will be responsible for guiding the careers of your direct reports, helping them realize their full potential while fostering a culture of forward-thinking design. With a practiced eye for quality, you will transform complex workflows into elegantly simple experiences. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product Management leaders to align business goals with design innovation, leveraging your passion for brand, craft, and execution.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”
 Responsibilities

• Drive the long-term User Experience (UX) goal for YouTube Studio and Creator Support, ensuring alignment across YouTube.

• Lead and mentor a high-performing, multi-disciplinary UX team across Zurich and Bangalore, fostering a collaborative culture.

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Content Design to influence stakeholders and align regional strategies.

• Advocate for scalable design systems while leveraging AI capabilities to enhance creator workflows and experience consistency.

• Maintain high visual and interaction quality standards while making informed product decisions grounded in creator needs.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, "Focus sull'utente e tutto il resto seguirà". Come UX Design Manager, guiderai questa visione definendo la strategia del prodotto, mitigando la complessità e concettualizzando l'UX a livello di ecosistema. Sei un pensatore di livello di sistemi e un feroce sostenitore sia per i tuoi utenti che per il tuo team.

Sarete responsabili di guidare le carriere dei vostri rapporti diretti, aiutandoli a realizzare il loro pieno potenziale, promuovendo una cultura del design in anticipo. Con un occhio praticato per la qualità, trasformerai i flussi di lavoro complessi in esperienze elegantemente semplici. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i leader di Engineering e Product Management per allineare gli obiettivi aziendali con l'innovazione del design, sfruttando la tua passione per il marchio, l'artigianato e l'esecuzione.

L'esperienza dell'utente è all'avanguardia nel modo in cui creiamo prodotti intuitivi, innovativi e belli che la gente ama. Ci sforziamo di imparare e comprendere le esigenze, i comportamenti e le emozioni dei nostri utenti per raccogliere informazioni che informano la strategia e il design del prodotto. I nostri team UX includono designer, ricercatori, strateghi dei contenuti e ingegneri che sono appassionati di qualità, usabilità e semplicità. Lavoriamo su team collaborativi per risolvere complesse sfide e esperienze artigianali che evidenziano le capacità e le personalità uniche dei nostri prodotti. Il nostro lavoro tocca miliardi esemplifica un principio chiave che è fondamentale per la filosofia di Google: “Focus sull’utente e tutto il resto seguirà”.

Über den Job
Bei Google konzentrieren wir uns auf den Benutzer und alles andere wird folgen. Als UX Design Manager werden Sie diese Vision vorantreiben, indem Sie Produktstrategien definieren, Komplexität verringern und UX auf Ökosystemebene konzipieren. Sie sind ein System-Level-Denker und ein leidenschaftlicher Fürsprecher für Ihre Benutzer und Ihr Team.

Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Karriere Ihrer direkten Berichte zu leiten und ihnen zu helfen, ihr volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen und gleichzeitig eine Kultur des zukunftsorientierten Designs zu fördern. Mit einem geübten Auge für Qualität verwandeln Sie komplexe Workflows in elegant einfache Erlebnisse. Sie werden eng mit Führungskräften im Bereich Engineering und Produktmanagement zusammenarbeiten, um Geschäftsziele mit Designinnovationen in Einklang zu bringen und Ihre Leidenschaft für Marke, Handwerk und Ausführung zu nutzen.

Die Benutzererfahrung steht an vorderster Front bei der Entwicklung intuitiver, innovativer und schöner Produkte, die die Menschen lieben. Wir bemühen uns, die Bedürfnisse, Verhaltensweisen und Emotionen unserer Benutzer zu lernen und zu verstehen, um Erkenntnisse zu sammeln, die die Produktstrategie und das Design beeinflussen. Unsere UX-Teams umfassen Designer, Forscher, Content-Strategen und Ingenieure, die sich für Qualität, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Einfachheit begeistern. Wir arbeiten in kollaborativen Teams, um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen und Handwerkserlebnisse zu schaffen, die die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Persönlichkeiten unserer Produkte hervorheben. Unsere Arbeit berührt Milliarden und veranschaulicht ein Schlüsselprinzip, das der Kern der Google-Philosophie ist: "Konzentrieren Sie sich auf den Benutzer und alles andere wird folgen."
Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie das langfristige Ziel der User Experience (UX) für YouTube Studio und Creator Support voran und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung auf YouTube.

• Führen und betreuen Sie ein leistungsstarkes, multidisziplinäres UX-Team in Zürich und Bangalore und fördern Sie eine kollaborative Kultur.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Engineering, Research und Content Design, um Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und regionale Strategien auszurichten.

• Setzen Sie sich für skalierbare Designsysteme ein und nutzen Sie gleichzeitig die KI-Fähigkeiten, um die Workflows der Ersteller zu verbessern und Konsistenz zu erleben.

• Halten Sie hohe visuelle und Interaktionsqualitätsstandards ein, während Sie fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen, die auf den Bedürfnissen des Schöpfers basieren.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages Python etc, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience in machine learning development and Machine Learning (ML) infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, or fine tuning) or large-scale data systems.

• Experience with relational databases and writing SQL queries.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with distributed infrastructure, storage, or application frameworks (such as Spanner or server platform).

• Experience or interest in Large Language Models (LLMs), Gemini, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, or graph neural networks/graph mining.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Commerce Safety team ensures a safe and trustworthy Google Commerce experience. We're on the front lines, protecting users and merchants by maintaining content and merchant integrity and compliance.

As a Software Engineer on the Actor Safety team, you will own and execute end-to-end components across the full-lifecycle development of our abuse intelligence stack including our detection models, agents and moderation platforms.People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.
 Responsibilities

• Contribute to and execute the actor safety strategy in collaboration with the PM and Eng leads by blending abuse prevention frameworks with targeted, tactical protections. Analyze complex abuse patterns and system precision/recall metrics to drive continuous improvements across our AI models (mScore, potential damage, identity change), detection systems, and operational workflows in close collaboration with partner Trust and Safety teams.

• Design, train, deploy, and iterate on ML models including Gemini LLMs, GNNs, and NLP architectures to detect spam, fraudulent actors, and abusive behaviour across shopping products. Build data pipelines for training data curation, establishing active learning workflows, synthetic datasets, and robust frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge) for model evaluation, monitoring, and performance tracking.

• Design and build high-throughput, resilient back-end services with production hygiene. Build our intelligence platform, managing models and seamlessly integrating with the actor lifecycle.

I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con le opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

In qualità di Ingegnere software del team di Sicurezza Attore, possiederai ed eseguirai componenti end-to-end attraverso lo sviluppo del ciclo di vita completo del nostro stack di intelligence contro gli abusi, inclusi i nostri modelli di rilevamento, agenti e piattaforme di moderazione. Sosteniamo e collaboriamo con l’ecosistema del commercio, dai grandi rivenditori ai piccoli commercianti locali, per dare loro gli strumenti, la tecnologia e la scala per prosperare nel mondo digitale di oggi.

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with distributed infrastructure, storage, or application frameworks (such as Spanner or server platform).

About the job

Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. The Commerce Safety team ensures a safe and trustworthy Google Commerce experience. We're on the front lines, protecting users and merchants by maintaining content and merchant integrity and compliance.

As a Software Engineer on the Actor Safety team, you will own and execute end-to-end components across the full-lifecycle development of our abuse intelligence stack including our detection models, agents and moderation platforms.People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.

Build data pipelines for training data curation, establishing active learning workflows, synthetic datasets, and robust frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge) for model evaluation, monitoring, and performance tracking.

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et l'autre. L'équipe de Sécurité du Commerce assure une expérience de Google Commerce sûre et fiable. Nous sommes en première ligne, protégeant les utilisateurs et les commerçants en maintenant le contenu et l'intégrité marchande et la conformité.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel de l'équipe de sécurité de l'acteur, vous posséderez et exécuterez des composants de bout en bout tout au long du cycle de vie complet de notre pile d'intelligence d'abus incluant nos modèles de détection, agents et plateformes de modération. Les gens magasinent sur Google plus d'un milliard de fois par jour - et l'équipe Commerce est responsable de construire les expériences qui servent ces utilisateurs. La mission de Google Commerce est d'être un élément essentiel du parcours d'achat pour les consommateurs - de l'inspiration à une expérience de caisse simple et sécurisée - et le meilleur endroit pour les détaillants/vendeurs pour se connecter avec les consommateurs. Nous soutenons l'écosystème du commerce, des grands détaillants aux petits marchands locaux, et nous nous associons à eux pour leur donner les outils, la technologie et l'échelle nécessaires pour prospérer dans le monde numérique d'aujourd'hui.

Titoli minimi

- Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. - 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato. - Esperienza con la codifica in C++.

Qualificazioni preferite

- 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi. - Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili. - Esperienza nell'immersione in dati complessi per scoprire connessioni, scrivere interrogazioni investigative e creare dashboard che traducano dati grezzi in intuizioni attuabili. - Un background nell'architettura software con un track record di gestione delle sfide in ambienti tecnici distribuiti.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre voi e il nostro business fast-paced crescono ed evolveranno. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership ed entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la stack mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Con la tua esperienza tecnica gestirai priorità di progetto, scadenze e risultati. Progetterai, svilupperai, testerai, implementerai, manterrai e migliorerai le soluzioni software.

In YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo sia un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio di tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività illimitata, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo condiviso per mostrare le persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e ci divertiamo. e lo facciamo tutti insieme.

Responsabilità

- Scrivi codice di sviluppo di prodotti o sistemi. - Partecipa o guida recensioni di design con i pari e stakeholder per decidere tra le tecnologie disponibili. - Revisiona il codice sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, checking code in, accuratezza, testabilità ed efficienza). - Contribuire alla documentazione esistente o contenuti educativi e adattare i contenuti in base agli aggiornamenti di prodotto/programma e feedback degli utenti.

- Problemi di prodotto o sistema triage e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.

• Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Experience deploying resources using Terraform or similar tools, to automate the setup of agents, functions, or networking.

• Experience building full-stack applications that interact with enterprise IT infrastructures, and developing external customer projects.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks like ReAct and self-reflection.

• Experience debugging Agent logic and optimizing tool selection, including tracing conversation IDs across microservices to identify and resolve failures in real-time.

• Experience connecting agents to enterprise knowledge bases and optimizing Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chunking to prevent hallucinations.

• Track record of troubleshooting live, high-traffic systems during critical windows.

• Ability to travel up to 50% of the time.

About the job
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI, you are the Agent Engineer and the primary driver for our customers' most critical AI initiatives. You take initial conversational prototypes and transform them into production-ready solutions, owning the end-to-end engineering life-cycle, including the transition from "Art-of-the-Possible" to real-world business value and scalable, secure AI systems. In this high-travel, high-impact role, you will be focused on leading technical delivery for Conversational AI pilots and establishing the first Customer User Journeys (CUJs) for our largest customers at their sites. You will require a deep understanding of software engineering, machine learning operations, and cloud infrastructure.
 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €104000 - €106000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Serve as the lead developer for complex Conversational AI and CX applications, transitioning from prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment.

• Architect and code conversational flows that are functional and optimized for the "connective tissue" between Google’s Conversational AI products and customers’ live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.

• Build high-performance evaluation (Eval) pipelines and observability frameworks to optimize agentic workloads, focusing on reasoning loops, tool selection, and reducing latency while maintaining production-grade security and networking.

• Identify repeatable field patterns and technical "friction points" in Google’s AAI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for Engineering teams.

• Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

• Master oder PhD in AI, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• Erleben Sie die Verbindung von Agenten mit Unternehmenswissensdatenbanken und die Optimierung von RAG-Chunking (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), um Halluzinationen zu verhindern.

Über den Job
Als Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in Applied AI sind Sie der Agent Engineer und der Haupttreiber für die wichtigsten KI-Initiativen unserer Kunden. Sie nehmen erste Gesprächsprototypen und verwandeln sie in produktionsfähige Lösungen, die den End-to-End-Engineering-Lebenszyklus besitzen, einschließlich des Übergangs von "Art-of-the-Possible" zu realem Geschäftswert und skalierbaren, sicheren KI-Systemen. In dieser anspruchsvollen und einflussreichen Rolle konzentrieren Sie sich auf die führende technische Lieferung von Conversational AI-Piloten und die Einrichtung der ersten Customer User Journeys (CUJs) für unsere größten Kunden an ihren Standorten. Sie benötigen ein tiefes Verständnis von Software Engineering, maschinellem Lernen und Cloud-Infrastruktur.
Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, dem Go-To-Market-Team von Google Cloud beizutreten, das die KI-Revolution für Unternehmen weltweit anführt. Sie werden sich auszeichnen, indem Sie die Glaubwürdigkeit der Marke von Google nutzen - ein Vermächtnis, das auf der Erfindung grundlegender Technologien basiert und sich in großem Maßstab bewährt hat. Wir bieten Ihnen das weltweit fortschrittlichste KI-Portfolio, einschließlich Frontier Gemini-Modelle, und die komplette Vertex AI-Plattform, die Ihnen hilft, Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. Wir sind eine kollaborative Kultur, die direkten Zugang zu DeepMinds Engineering- und Forschungsteams bietet und Sie in die Lage versetzt, Kundenherausforderungen zu lösen. Seien Sie mit uns der Katalysator für unsere Mission, treiben Sie den Kundenerfolg voran und definieren Sie die neue Cloud-Ära – der Markt gehört Ihnen.
Die individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie berufsbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Bildung oder Ausbildung bestimmt.

• Architekten- und Code-Konversationsflüsse, die funktional und für das "Verbindungsgewebe" zwischen Googles Conversational AI-Produkten und der Live-Infrastruktur der Kunden optimiert sind, einschließlich APIs, Legacy-Datensilos und Sicherheitsperimetern.

• Identifizieren Sie wiederholbare Feldmuster und technische "Reibungspunkte" im AAI-Stack von Google und konvertieren Sie sie in wiederverwendbare Module oder Produktfunktionsanforderungen für Engineering-Teams.

• Co-Build mit Kunden-Engineering-Teams, um Best Practices für die Entwicklung von Google zu entwickeln und so langfristigen Projekterfolg und eine hohe Akzeptanz durch den Endbenutzer zu gewährleisten.

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en intelligence artificielle, informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• Expérience de la mise en œuvre de systèmes multi-agents en utilisant des cadres comme ReAct et l'auto-réflexion.

Sur le travail
En tant qu'ingénieur avancé déployé (FDE) dans l'IA appliquée, vous êtes l'ingénieur agent et le principal moteur des initiatives d'IA les plus critiques de nos clients. Vous prenez des prototypes conversationnels initiaux et les transformez en solutions prêtes à la production, possédant le cycle de vie d'ingénierie de bout en bout, y compris la transition de l'Art-of-the-Possible à la valeur commerciale réelle et les systèmes d'IA évolutives et sécurisés. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre l'équipe Go-To-Market de Google Cloud, qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les entreprises du monde entier. Vous excellerez en tirant parti de la crédibilité de la marque de Google – un héritage fondé sur l'invention de technologies fondamentales et prouvé à l'échelle. Nous vous fournissons le portefeuille AI le plus avancé au monde, y compris les modèles frontière Gemini, et la plateforme Altex AI complète, vous aidant à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires. Nous sommes une culture collaborative offrant un accès direct aux esprits d'ingénierie et de recherche de DeepMind, vous permettant de résoudre les défis des clients. Rejoignez-nous pour être le catalyseur de notre mission, stimuler le succès client et définir la nouvelle ère du cloud – le marché est à vous.

• Construire des pipelines d'évaluation de haute performance (Eval) et des cadres d'observation afin d'optimiser la charge de travail des agents, en mettant l'accent sur les boucles de raisonnement, la sélection d'outils et la réduction de la latence tout en maintenant la sécurité de production et le réseautage.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field in the EMEA region, and in your penultimate/final year of education.

• Experience in one or more Research areas: Natural Language Understanding/Processing, Computer Vision, LLMs, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, AI/ML Algorithms, Deep Learning or Image Processing, multimodal, multilingual and reinforcement learning.

• Experience and profiency in one or more general purpose programming languages: Java, C++, Python, or Go.

• Experience with research from previous internships, full-time industry experience, personal projects, lab work, or published papers (being listed as author).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.

• Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals.

• Ability to design and execute on research agendas.

• Ability to complete a 13-17 week full-time internship in Switzerland, France or Germany starting in either May, June or July 2027.

About the job
 Research happens at Google everyday, on many different embedded teams throughout the company. Our research reaches the user through both services and products such as Search, Maps, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, and our computing, storage, and networking infrastructure. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible. At Google, research-focused engineering interns are embedded throughout the company, contributing to the setup of large-scale tests and deploying promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, research-focused engineering interns work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and more.
 Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.
 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
 France: €66000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target
 Denmark: kr.670000 (DKK) + 0% bonus target
 Learn more about benefits at Google .

Responsibilities

• Participate in research to develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

• Research, conceive, and develop software applications to extend and improve on Google's product offering.

• Contribute to a wide variety of projects utilizing natural language processing, artificial intelligence, data compression, machine learning, and search technologies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Attualmente iscritta in un dottorato di ricerca in Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato nella regione EMEA, e nel vostro penultimo/ultimo anno di istruzione.

• Esperienza in uno o più ambiti di ricerca: Comprensione/Processsing del linguaggio naturale, Visione del computer, LLM, Fondazioni algoritmiche di ottimizzazione, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, Algoritmi AI/ML, Deep Learning or Image Processing, apprendimento multimodale, multilingue e rafforzamento dell'apprendimento.

• Esperienza e competenza in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione generali: Java, C++, Python o Go.

• Esperienza con la ricerca di stage precedenti, esperienza nel settore a tempo pieno, progetti personali, lavoro di laboratorio o pubblicazioni (essere elencati come autore).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza come ricercatore, tra cui stage, a tempo pieno, o in un laboratorio.

• Esperienza contribuendo a comunità o sforzi di ricerca, tra cui pubblicazioni in conferenze o riviste.

• Capacità di progettare ed eseguire in agenda di ricerca.

• Capacità di completare un tirocinio di 13-17 settimane a tempo pieno in Svizzera, Francia o Germania a partire da maggio, giugno o luglio 2027.

Riguardo al lavoro
La ricerca avviene ogni giorno su Google, su molte diverse squadre incorporate in tutta la società. La nostra ricerca raggiunge l'utente attraverso servizi e prodotti come ricerca, mappe, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, e la nostra infrastruttura di elaborazione, archiviazione e networking. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, stiamo lavorando su progetti che utilizzano le ultime tecnologie che spingono i confini di ciò che è possibile. A Google, gli stagisti di ingegneria focalizzati sulla ricerca sono incorporati in tutta l'azienda, contribuendo alla messa a punto di test su larga scala e la distribuzione di idee promettenti in modo rapido e ampio. Le idee possono provenire da progetti interni e da collaborazioni con programmi di ricerca presso università partner e istituti tecnici in tutto il mondo. Dalla creazione di esperimenti e implementazioni di prototipazione alla progettazione di architetture, intern ingegneristici focalizzati sulla ricerca lavorano su problemi del mondo reale, tra cui intelligenza artificiale, data mining, elaborazione della lingua naturale, analisi hardware e software delle prestazioni, migliorare compilatori per piattaforme mobili, così come la ricerca del core e altro ancora.
Google Research affronta le sfide che definiscono la tecnologia di oggi e di domani. Dal condurre una ricerca fondamentale per influenzare lo sviluppo del prodotto, i nostri team di ricerca hanno l'opportunità di influenzare la tecnologia utilizzata da miliardi di persone ogni giorno.

I nostri team aspirano a fare scoperte che colpiscono tutti, e core al nostro approccio sta condividendo la nostra ricerca e strumenti per alimentare il progresso nel campo -- pubblichiamo regolarmente in riviste accademiche, rilasciano progetti come open source, e applichiamo la ricerca ai prodotti di Google.

responsabilità

• Ricerca, concepimento e sviluppo di applicazioni software per estendere e migliorare l'offerta di prodotti di Google.

• Contribuisci a una vasta gamma di progetti che utilizzano l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, l'intelligenza artificiale, la compressione dei dati, l'apprendimento automatico e le tecnologie di ricerca.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field in the EMEA region, and in your penultimate/final year of education.

• Experience in one or more Research areas: Natural Language Understanding/Processing, Computer Vision, LLMs, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, AI/ML Algorithms, Deep Learning or Image Processing, multimodal, multilingual and reinforcement learning.

• Experience and profiency in one or more general purpose programming languages: Java, C++, Python, or Go.

• Experience with research from previous internships, full-time industry experience, personal projects, lab work, or published papers (being listed as author).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.

• Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals.

• Ability to design and execute on research agendas.

• Ability to complete a 13-17 week full-time internship in Switzerland, France or Germany starting in either May, June or July 2027.

About the job
Research happens at Google everyday, on many different embedded teams throughout the company. Our research reaches the user through both services and products such as Search, Maps, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, and our computing, storage, and networking infrastructure. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible. At Google, research-focused engineering interns are embedded throughout the company, contributing to the setup of large-scale tests and deploying promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, research-focused engineering interns work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and more.
Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
France: €66000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Participate in research to develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Vision, Robotics, 3D sensing, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in Computer Vision, Robotics, or related fields.

• Experience contributing to research in the field of 3D surface reconstruction and semantic scene understanding.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience working in AR/VR/XR.

• Experience working with mobile DSPs for ML network acceleration.

• Strong skills in modern ML frameworks, VLMs, 3D math, real-time system implications of ML workloads.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by
breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where
lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €128000 - €131000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and deploy lightweight scene representations to capture world-facing context signals and enable contextual triggers and panel placement for XR glasses.

• Create suitable ego-centric datasets, as well as the fusion and evaluation of different foundation models for building robust object- and scene-centric representations in real-time.

• Interface these representations with Gemini/Gemma variants. This unlocks powerful context-aware AI capabilities, such as voice-based spatial placement and on-device scene understanding for Spatial Gemini. Create and curate suitable ego-centric datasets, as well as the fusion and evaluation of different foundation models for building robust object- and scene-centric representations in real-time.

Qualifiche minime:

• Laurea in Visione Computer, Robotica, Sensazione 3D, un campo correlato o un'esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza in Visione Computer, Robotica o campi correlati.

• Esperienza che contribuisce alla ricerca nel campo della ricostruzione della superficie 3D e della comprensione semantica della scena.

Qualificazioni preferite:

• Esperienza lavorativa in AR/VR/XR.

• Esperienza lavorando con i sistemi mobili DSP per l'accelerazione della rete ML.

• Forte abilità nei moderni quadri ML, VLM, matematica 3D, implicazioni del sistema in tempo reale dei carichi di lavoro ML.

I nostri prodotti devono gestire informazioni su larga scala e andare ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portino idee nuove da tutti i settori, tra cui il recupero delle informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione di linguaggi naturali, il design di UI e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti.

Con la tua esperienza tecnica gestirai priorità di progetto, scadenze e risultati. Progetterai, svilupperai, testerai, implementerai, manterrai e migliorerai le soluzioni software.

Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da scoperte in compute, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. Il team XR di Google è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di nuovi dispositivi. si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi.

Stiamo costruendo un futuro dove dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali e cuffie intelligenti si accoppiano con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversazionali e contestuali.La paga individuale è determinata da fattori tra cui competenze legate al lavoro, esperienza, e l'istruzione o formazione pertinenti.

Germania: 128000 euro - 131000 euro + 15% di bonus target + capitale netto + benefici

Learn più circa i benefici a Google. Responsabilità

• Progettare, implementare e implementare rappresentazioni di scena leggere per catturare segnali di contesto rivolti al mondo e consentire trigger contestuali e posizionamento del pannello per gli occhiali XR.

• Creare dataset egocentrici adatti, nonché la fusione e la valutazione di diversi modelli di fondazione per costruire robuste rappresentazioni oggettuali e scenografiche in tempo reale.

• Interfaccia queste rappresentazioni con le varianti Gemini/Gemma. Questo sblocca potenti funzionalità AI contestuali, come il posizionamento spaziale vocale e la comprensione della scena in modalità on-device per Spatial Gemini. Crea e distribuisci set di dati egocentrici adatti, così come la fusione e la valutazione di diversi modelli di fondazione per la costruzione di rappresentazioni robuste ogget- e scene-centriche in tempo reale.

Nous construisons un avenir où des appareils XR légers comme des lunettes intelligentes et des casques s'apparententent à une AI utile pour augmenter l'intelligence humaine, offrant des expériences personnalisées, conversationnelles et contextuelles.La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences liées au travail, l'expérience, et l'éducation ou la formation pertinente.

Allemagne: 128000 € - 131000 € (EUR) + 15% de bonus + capitaux propres + avantages

En savoir plus sur les avantages chez Google. Responsabilités

• Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et déployer des représentations de scènes légères pour capter les signaux contextuels faisant face au monde et permettre les déclencheurs contextuels et le placement de panneaux pour les lunettes XR.

• Créer des ensembles de données égocentriques adaptés, ainsi que la fusion et l'évaluation de différents modèles de base pour construire des représentations robustes centrées sur les objets et les scènes en temps réel.

• Interface de ces représentations avec des variantes Gemini/Gemme. Cela permet de débloquer des capacités d'IA contextuelles puissantes, comme le placement spatial basé sur la voix et la compréhension sur la scène sur les appareils pour les Gémeaux Spatiaux. Créer et arranger des ensembles de données ego-centriques adaptés, ainsi que la fusion et l'évaluation de différents modèles de base pour construire des représentations robustes centrées sur les objets et les scènes en temps réel.

titleByLocale.de: Mitarbeiter UX Designer Lead, Studio Content Publishing
titleByLocale.fr: Personnel UX Designer Lead, Studio Content Publishing

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in product design or User Experience (UX).

• Experience designing creator tools, video editing workflows, content management systems (CMS), or media publishing platforms.

• Experience leading and mentoring cross-functional UX designers and managing multi-year product design goals.

• Include a portfolio, website, or any other related link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 12 years of experience in product design or UX.

• 5 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.

About the job
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.
User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”
 Responsibilities

• Modernize core upload and publish flows, smart drafts, and comprehensive metadata editing to take the anxiety and friction out of publishing. Lead the design of intuitive interfaces that ensure creators can confidently and efficiently publish their content.

• Craft intelligent, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered tools and optimizations for titles, thumbnails, tags, and metadata that maximize a creator’s reach and audience engagement. Transform complex machine learning models into accessible, actionable insights for creators.

• Empower storytelling through advanced capabilities like title and thumbnail A/B testing and seamless integrations with powerful video editing platforms. Streamline creator workflows from creation through post-production.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nella progettazione dei prodotti o esperienza utente (UX).

• Prova a progettare strumenti di creazione, flussi di lavoro di editing video, sistemi di gestione dei contenuti (CMS), o piattaforme di pubblicazione multimediale.

• Esperienza leader e mentoring cross-functional designer UX e gestione degli obiettivi di progettazione di prodotti pluriennali.

• Includere un portafoglio, un sito web o qualsiasi altro link relativo al tuo lavoro nel tuo curriculum (fornire un link visibile o istruzioni di accesso).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale in Design, Interazione Umana-Computer, Scienza informatica, un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 12 anni di esperienza nella progettazione del prodotto o UX.

• 5 anni di esperienza che lavorano in un'organizzazione complessa e interfunzionale.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, "Focus sull'utente e tutto il resto seguirà". I nostri progettisti di interazione trasformano compiti complessi in esperienze intuitive e facili da usare per miliardi di persone. Dalla creazione di flussi utente e wireframe per la costruzione di mockup e prototipi, si prevede e portare a vita esperienze di prodotto con un'atmosfera ispirata, raffinata e magica. Ti unirai al nostro team UX multidisciplinare, collaborando con Engineering e Product Management, sfruttando le informazioni degli utenti per creare prodotti leader nel settore.

In qualità di Interaction Designer, applicherai metodi di progettazione orientati all'utente per creare esperienze utente leader del settore dal concetto all'esecuzione, lavorando con partner di design per evolvere il linguaggio di design di Google per costruire prodotti belli e innovativi.
L'esperienza dell'utente è all'avanguardia nel modo in cui creiamo prodotti intuitivi, innovativi e belli che la gente ama. Ci sforziamo di imparare e comprendere le esigenze, i comportamenti e le emozioni dei nostri utenti per raccogliere informazioni che informano la strategia e il design del prodotto. I nostri team UX includono designer, ricercatori, strateghi dei contenuti e ingegneri che sono appassionati di qualità, usabilità e semplicità. Lavoriamo su team collaborativi per risolvere complesse sfide e esperienze artigianali che evidenziano le capacità e le personalità uniche dei nostri prodotti. Il nostro lavoro tocca miliardi esemplifica un principio chiave che è fondamentale per la filosofia di Google: “Focus sull’utente e tutto il resto seguirà”.
responsabilità

• Modernizzare il core upload e pubblicare flussi, bozze intelligenti e l'editing completo dei metadati per eliminare l'ansia e l'attrito dalla pubblicazione. Guidare la progettazione di interfacce intuitive che garantiscono ai creatori di poter pubblicare con sicurezza ed efficacia i loro contenuti.

• Strumenti e ottimizzazioni per titoli, miniature, tag e metadati che massimizzano la portata e l’impegno di un creatore. Trasforma modelli di machine learning complessi in informazioni accessibili e attuabili per i creatori.

• Incoraggia la narrazione attraverso funzionalità avanzate come test di titolo e thumbnail A/B e integrazioni senza soluzione di continuità con potenti piattaforme di editing video. Semplificare i flussi di lavoro dei creatori dalla creazione attraverso la post-produzione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign oder User Experience (UX).

• Erleben Sie das Entwerfen von Creator-Tools, Videobearbeitungs-Workflows, Content-Management-Systemen (CMS) oder Medienveröffentlichungsplattformen.

• Erleben Sie führende und betreuende funktionsübergreifende UX-Designer und verwalten Sie mehrjährige Produktdesignziele.

• Fügen Sie ein Portfolio, eine Website oder einen anderen verwandten Link zu Ihrer Arbeit in Ihren Lebenslauf ein (mit einem sichtbaren Link oder Zugangsanweisungen).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss in Design, Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Informatik, einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 12 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign oder UX.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer komplexen, funktionsübergreifenden Organisation.

Über den Job
Bei Google konzentrieren wir uns auf den Benutzer und alles andere wird folgen. Unsere Interaction Designer verwandeln komplexe Aufgaben in intuitive, benutzerfreundliche Erlebnisse für Milliarden von Menschen. Vom Erstellen von Benutzerströmen und Wireframes bis hin zum Erstellen von Mockups und Prototypen werden Sie sich Produkterlebnisse mit einem inspirierten, raffinierten und magischen Gefühl vorstellen und zum Leben erwecken. Sie werden unserem multidisziplinären UX-Team beitreten, das mit Engineering und Produktmanagement zusammenarbeitet und Benutzereinblicke nutzt, um branchenführende Produkte zu entwickeln.

Als Interaktionsdesigner wenden Sie benutzerzentrierte Designmethoden an, um branchenführende Benutzererfahrungen vom Konzept bis zur Ausführung zu erstellen, und arbeiten mit Designpartnern zusammen, um die Google-Designsprache zu entwickeln, um schöne, innovative Produkte zu entwickeln.
Die Benutzererfahrung steht an vorderster Front bei der Entwicklung intuitiver, innovativer und schöner Produkte, die die Menschen lieben. Wir bemühen uns, die Bedürfnisse, Verhaltensweisen und Emotionen unserer Benutzer zu lernen und zu verstehen, um Erkenntnisse zu sammeln, die die Produktstrategie und das Design beeinflussen. Unsere UX-Teams umfassen Designer, Forscher, Content-Strategen und Ingenieure, die sich für Qualität, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Einfachheit begeistern. Wir arbeiten in kollaborativen Teams, um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen und Handwerkserlebnisse zu schaffen, die die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Persönlichkeiten unserer Produkte hervorheben. Unsere Arbeit berührt Milliarden und veranschaulicht ein Schlüsselprinzip, das der Kern der Google-Philosophie ist: "Konzentrieren Sie sich auf den Benutzer und alles andere wird folgen."
Zuständigkeiten

• Modernisieren Sie Core-Upload- und -Publishing-Flows, intelligente Entwürfe und umfassende Metadaten-Bearbeitung, um die Angst und Reibung aus der Veröffentlichung zu nehmen. Führen Sie das Design von intuitiven Schnittstellen, die sicherstellen, dass Entwickler ihre Inhalte sicher und effizient veröffentlichen können.

• Erstellen Sie intelligente, auf künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) basierende Tools und Optimierungen für Titel, Thumbnails, Tags und Metadaten, die die Reichweite und das Publikumsengagement eines Schöpfers maximieren. Verwandeln Sie komplexe Machine-Learning-Modelle in zugängliche, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Entwickler.

• Ermöglichen Sie Storytelling durch erweiterte Funktionen wie Titel- und Thumbnail-A/B-Tests und nahtlose Integrationen mit leistungsstarken Videobearbeitungsplattformen. Streamline Creator Workflows von der Erstellung bis zur Postproduktion.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 8 ans d'expérience en conception de produits ou expérience utilisateur (UX).

• Expérience de conception d'outils créateurs, de flux de travail d'édition vidéo, de systèmes de gestion de contenu (CMS) ou de plateformes de publication multimédia.

• Expérimentez le leadership et le mentorat des concepteurs UX multifonctionnels et la gestion des objectifs pluriannuels de conception de produits.

• Inclure un portfolio, un site Web ou tout autre lien connexe à votre travail dans votre CV (fournissant un lien visible ou des instructions d'accès).

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise en conception, interaction homme-ordinateur, informatique, domaine connexe ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 12 ans d'expérience dans la conception de produits ou UX.

• 5 ans d'expérience dans une organisation complexe et interfonctionnelle.

Sur le travail
Chez Google, nous "Focus sur l'utilisateur et tout le reste suivra." Nos concepteurs d'interaction transforment des tâches complexes en expériences intuitives et faciles à utiliser pour des milliards de personnes. De la création de flux d'utilisateurs et de trames filaires à la construction de maquettes et de prototypes, vous pourrez imaginer et vivre des expériences de produits avec une sensation inspirée, raffinée et magique. Vous vous joindrez à notre équipe multidisciplinaire UX, collaborant avec l'ingénierie et la gestion des produits, en tirant parti des connaissances des utilisateurs pour créer des produits de pointe.

En tant que concepteur d'interactions, vous appliquerez des méthodes de conception centrées sur l'utilisateur à l'artisanat - une expérience utilisateur de pointe du concept à l'exécution, en travaillant avec des partenaires de conception pour développer le langage de conception Google pour construire de beaux produits innovants.
L'expérience utilisateur est à l'avant-garde de la façon dont nous créons des produits intuitifs, innovants et beaux que les gens aiment. Nous nous efforçons d'apprendre et de comprendre les besoins, les comportements et les émotions de nos utilisateurs afin de recueillir des idées qui éclairent la stratégie et la conception des produits. Nos équipes UX comprennent des concepteurs, des chercheurs, des stratèges de contenu et des ingénieurs passionnés par la qualité, la convivialité et la simplicité. Nous travaillons sur des équipes collaboratives pour résoudre des défis complexes et des expériences d'artisanat qui mettent en valeur nos produits. Notre travail touche des milliards tout en exemplifiant un principe clé qui est le cœur de la philosophie de Google.
Responsabilités

• Moderniser les flux de téléchargement et de publication, les ébauches intelligentes et l'édition complète des métadonnées pour éliminer l'anxiété et les frictions de la publication. Diriger la conception d'interfaces intuitives qui permettent aux créateurs de publier leur contenu avec confiance et efficacité.

• Artisanat intelligent, Intelligence Artificielle (AI)-puissant des outils et des optimisations pour les titres, vignettes, balises et métadonnées qui maximisent la portée d'un créateur et l'engagement du public. Transformer des modèles complexes d'apprentissage automatique en idées accessibles et réalisables pour les créateurs.

• Empower storytelling grâce à des capacités avancées comme le titre et la vignette test A/B et des intégrations sans faille avec de puissantes plateformes de montage vidéo. Rationaliser les flux de travail des créateurs depuis la création jusqu'à la postproduction.
