jobs.title: Research Software Engineer, Distributed Systems, Artificial Life, Pi

titleByLocale.it: Ricerca Software Ingegnere, Distributed Systems, Artificial Life, Pi
titleByLocale.en: Research Software Engineer, Distributed Systems, Artificial Life, Pi
titleByLocale.de: Forschung Software Ingenieur, Distributed Systems, Artificial Life, Pi
titleByLocale.fr: Recherche Software Ingénieur, Distributed Systems, Artificial Life, Pi

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience in software development, with a focus on distributed computing and parallelizable infrastructure.

• Experience scaling systems from single-CPU runs to distributed environments.

• Experience with infrastructure optimization and resource management.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

• Experience with evolutionary algorithms, machine learning research, or artificial life simulations.

• Experience building infrastructure that interfaces with real-world programming benchmarks (e.g., LeetCode, code golf).

• Demonstrated ability to handle the increased complexity and geographical segregation of populations within digital ecosystems.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Paradigms of Intelligence (Pi) is an interdisciplinary research team exploring the fundamental building blocks of intelligence. One of our major projects, seeks to develop radically open-ended artificial-life systems for program evolution to demonstrate the emergence of foundational-evolution.
 In this role, you will apply your expertise in distributed simulations to manage massive-scale environments for frontier machine learning research. You will build modular, efficient infrastructure for running and analyzing artificial life simulations, supporting self-replicating systems that learn to solve complex problems within their ecological niche.
 Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.

Responsibilities

• Build large-scale simulations and manage distributed computing infrastructure to scale digital ecosystems and experiments.

• Create modular infrastructure capable of running experiments with trillions of generated programs and complex interactions.

• Optimize compute usage and efficiently manage significant CPU resource requirements across shared infrastructure.

• Implement efficient scheduling, resolve job failures, and ensure that massive-scale runs execute reliably.

• Provide dedicated engineering support to accelerate data analysis and the launching of new experiments.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Qualifiche minime:

• Laurea triennale in Informatica, settore tecnico correlato o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 2 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software, con particolare attenzione al calcolo distribuito e all'infrastruttura parallelizzabile.

• Esperienza nella scalabilità dei sistemi da esecuzioni con CPU singola ad ambienti distribuiti.

• Esperienza nell'ottimizzazione delle infrastrutture e nella gestione delle risorse.

Qualifiche preferite:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato di ricerca in informatica, intelligenza artificiale o campo correlato.

• Esperienza con algoritmi evolutivi, ricerca sull'apprendimento automatico o simulazioni di vita artificiale.

• Esperienza nella costruzione di infrastrutture che si interfacciano con benchmark di programmazione del mondo reale (ad esempio, LeetCode, code golf).

• Dimostrata capacità di gestire la crescente complessità e la segregazione geografica delle popolazioni all'interno degli ecosistemi digitali.

Riguardo il lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di prossima generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e tra loro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire informazioni su vasta scala e estendersi ben oltre la ricerca sul Web. Cerchiamo ingegneri che portino nuove idee da tutte le aree, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, elaborazione distribuita, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e archiviazione dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, progettazione dell'interfaccia utente e dispositivi mobili; l'elenco continua e cresce ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico fondamentale per le esigenze di Google con l'opportunità di cambiare team e progetto man mano che tu e la nostra frenetica attività crescete ed evolvete. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi a tutto campo mentre continuiamo a portare avanti la tecnologia.

Con la tua competenza tecnica gestirai le priorità, le scadenze e i risultati finali del progetto. Progetterai, svilupperai, testerai, distribuirai, manterrai e migliorerai le soluzioni software.

Paradigms of Intelligence (Pi) è un gruppo di ricerca interdisciplinare che esplora gli elementi fondamentali dell'intelligenza. Uno dei nostri progetti più importanti mira a sviluppare sistemi di vita artificiale radicalmente aperti per l'evoluzione del programma per dimostrare l'emergere dell'evoluzione fondamentale.
In questo ruolo, applicherai la tua esperienza nelle simulazioni distribuite per gestire ambienti su vasta scala per la ricerca di frontiera sul machine learning. Costruirai un'infrastruttura modulare ed efficiente per eseguire e analizzare simulazioni di vita artificiale, supportando sistemi autoreplicanti che imparano a risolvere problemi complessi all'interno della loro nicchia ecologica.
Google Research affronta le sfide che definiscono la tecnologia di oggi e di domani. Dalla conduzione di ricerche fondamentali all'influenza sullo sviluppo dei prodotti, i nostri team di ricerca hanno l'opportunità di influenzare la tecnologia utilizzata ogni giorno da miliardi di persone.

I nostri team aspirano a fare scoperte che abbiano un impatto su tutti e il fulcro del nostro approccio è condividere la nostra ricerca e i nostri strumenti per promuovere il progresso nel campo: pubblichiamo regolarmente su riviste accademiche, rilasciamo progetti come open source e applichiamo la ricerca ai prodotti Google.

Responsabilità

• Costruire simulazioni su larga scala e gestire l'infrastruttura informatica distribuita per scalare ecosistemi ed esperimenti digitali.

• Creare un'infrastruttura modulare in grado di eseguire esperimenti con trilioni di programmi generati e interazioni complesse.

• Ottimizzare l'utilizzo del computer e gestire in modo efficiente i requisiti significativi di risorse della CPU nell'infrastruttura condivisa.

• Implementare una pianificazione efficiente, risolvere gli errori dei processi e garantire che le esecuzioni su vasta scala vengano eseguite in modo affidabile.

• Fornire supporto tecnico dedicato per accelerare l'analisi dei dati e il lancio di nuovi esperimenti.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.

Responsibilities

• Build large-scale simulations and manage distributed computing infrastructure to scale digital ecosystems and experiments.

• Create modular infrastructure capable of running experiments with trillions of generated programs and complex interactions.

• Optimize compute usage and efficiently manage significant CPU resource requirements across shared infrastructure.

• Implement efficient scheduling, resolve job failures, and ensure that massive-scale runs execute reliably.

• Provide dedicated engineering support to accelerate data analysis and the launching of new experiments.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, einem verwandten technischen Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Schwerpunkt auf verteiltem Computing und parallelisierbarer Infrastruktur.

• Erleben Sie die Skalierung von Systemen von Einzel-CPU-Läufen bis hin zu verteilten Umgebungen.

• Erfahrung mit Infrastrukturoptimierung und Ressourcenmanagement.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder Doktortitel in Informatik, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Erfahrung mit evolutionären Algorithmen, maschineller Lernforschung oder künstlichen Lebenssimulationen.

• Erleben Sie den Aufbau einer Infrastruktur, die mit realen Programmier-Benchmarks (z. B. LeetCode, Code Golf) kompatibel ist.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mit der zunehmenden Komplexität und geografischen Segregation von Populationen innerhalb digitaler Ökosysteme umzugehen.

Über den Job
Die Softwareentwickler von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern sich mit Informationen und untereinander verbinden, sie erkunden und mit ihnen interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Rechnen, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobilgeräte; Die Liste geht weiter und wird jeden Tag länger. Als Softwareentwickler arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen Projekt, das für die Anforderungen von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, und haben die Möglichkeit, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen von unseren Ingenieuren Vielseitigkeit, Führungsqualitäten und die Begeisterung, neue Probleme im gesamten Spektrum anzugehen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Mit Ihrem technischen Fachwissen verwalten Sie Projektprioritäten, Fristen und Ergebnisse. Sie entwerfen, entwickeln, testen, implementieren, warten und verbessern Softwarelösungen.

Paradigms of Intelligence (Pi) ist ein interdisziplinäres Forschungsteam, das die grundlegenden Bausteine ​​der Intelligenz erforscht. Eines unserer Hauptprojekte zielt darauf ab, völlig offene künstliche Lebenssysteme für die Programmentwicklung zu entwickeln, um die Entstehung einer grundlegenden Evolution zu demonstrieren.
In dieser Rolle wenden Sie Ihr Fachwissen in verteilten Simulationen an, um groß angelegte Umgebungen für die bahnbrechende Forschung im Bereich maschinelles Lernen zu verwalten. Sie bauen eine modulare, effiziente Infrastruktur zum Ausführen und Analysieren künstlicher Lebenssimulationen auf und unterstützen sich selbst reproduzierende Systeme, die lernen, komplexe Probleme in ihrer ökologischen Nische zu lösen.
Google Research befasst sich mit Herausforderungen, die die Technologie von heute und morgen bestimmen. Von der Grundlagenforschung bis zur Beeinflussung der Produktentwicklung haben unsere Forschungsteams die Möglichkeit, Einfluss auf die Technologie zu nehmen, die täglich von Milliarden Menschen genutzt wird.

Unsere Teams streben danach, Entdeckungen zu machen, die alle betreffen. Der Kern unseres Ansatzes besteht darin, unsere Forschungsergebnisse und Tools zu teilen, um den Fortschritt auf diesem Gebiet voranzutreiben. Wir veröffentlichen regelmäßig in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, veröffentlichen Projekte als Open Source und wenden die Forschung auf Google-Produkte an.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Erstellen Sie groß angelegte Simulationen und verwalten Sie eine verteilte Computerinfrastruktur, um digitale Ökosysteme und Experimente zu skalieren.

• Erstellen Sie eine modulare Infrastruktur, die in der Lage ist, Experimente mit Billionen generierten Programmen und komplexen Interaktionen durchzuführen.

• Optimieren Sie die Rechennutzung und verwalten Sie erhebliche CPU-Ressourcenanforderungen in der gesamten gemeinsam genutzten Infrastruktur effizient.

• Implementieren Sie eine effiziente Planung, beheben Sie Auftragsfehler und stellen Sie sicher, dass umfangreiche Läufe zuverlässig ausgeführt werden.

• Bieten Sie dedizierte technische Unterstützung, um die Datenanalyse und den Start neuer Experimente zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qualifications minimales :

• Baccalauréat en informatique, dans un domaine technique connexe ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 2 ans d'expérience en développement de logiciels, avec un accent sur l'informatique distribuée et les infrastructures parallélisables.

• Expérience dans la mise à l'échelle de systèmes depuis des exécutions à processeur unique vers des environnements distribués.

• Expérience en optimisation d'infrastructure et en gestion de ressources.

Diplômes souhaités :

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique, en intelligence artificielle ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Expérience avec les algorithmes évolutionnaires, la recherche sur l'apprentissage automatique ou les simulations de vie artificielle.

• Expérience dans la création d'infrastructures qui s'interfacent avec des références de programmation du monde réel (par exemple, LeetCode, code golf).

• Capacité démontrée à gérer la complexité croissante et la ségrégation géographique des populations au sein des écosystèmes numériques.

À propos du travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent des technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la façon dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec les informations et entre eux. Nos produits doivent traiter des informations à grande échelle et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche sur le Web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, notamment la recherche d'informations, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, les réseaux et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et le mobile ; la liste est longue et s'allonge chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique essentiel aux besoins de Google avec la possibilité de changer d'équipe et de projet à mesure que vous et notre entreprise en évolution rapide grandissez et évoluez. Nous avons besoin que nos ingénieurs soient polyvalents, fassent preuve de qualités de leadership et soient enthousiastes à l'idée de résoudre de nouveaux problèmes dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise tout en continuant à faire progresser la technologie.

Grâce à votre expertise technique, vous gérerez les priorités, les délais et les livrables du projet. Vous concevrez, développerez, testerez, déploierez, maintiendrez et améliorerez des solutions logicielles.

Paradigms of Intelligence (Pi) est une équipe de recherche interdisciplinaire explorant les éléments fondamentaux de l’intelligence. L'un de nos projets majeurs vise à développer des systèmes de vie artificielle radicalement ouverts pour l'évolution des programmes afin de démontrer l'émergence de l'évolution fondamentale.
Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez votre expertise dans les simulations distribuées pour gérer des environnements à grande échelle pour la recherche de pointe sur l'apprentissage automatique. Vous construirez une infrastructure modulaire et efficace pour exécuter et analyser des simulations de vie artificielle, prenant en charge des systèmes auto-réplicatifs qui apprennent à résoudre des problèmes complexes au sein de leur niche écologique.
Google Research aborde les défis qui définissent la technologie d'aujourd'hui et de demain. Qu'il s'agisse de mener des recherches fondamentales ou d'influencer le développement de produits, nos équipes de recherche ont la possibilité d'avoir un impact sur la technologie utilisée par des milliards de personnes chaque jour.

Nos équipes aspirent à faire des découvertes qui impactent tout le monde, et le partage de nos recherches et de nos outils est au cœur de notre approche pour alimenter les progrès dans le domaine : nous publions régulièrement dans des revues universitaires, publions des projets en open source et appliquons la recherche aux produits Google.

Responsabilités

• Créez des simulations à grande échelle et gérez l'infrastructure informatique distribuée pour faire évoluer les écosystèmes et les expériences numériques.

• Créer une infrastructure modulaire capable d'exécuter des expériences avec des milliards de programmes générés et des interactions complexes.

• Optimisez l'utilisation du calcul et gérez efficacement les besoins importants en ressources CPU sur l'infrastructure partagée.

• Mettez en œuvre une planification efficace, résolvez les échecs de tâches et assurez-vous que les exécutions à grande échelle s'exécutent de manière fiable.

• Fournir un support technique dédié pour accélérer l'analyse des données et le lancement de nouvelles expériences.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field in the EMEA region.

• Experience working with data structures or algorithms during coursework/projects, research, internships or practical experience in school or work (e.g., open-source coding).

• Coding experience in one of the following programming languages: Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript.

Preferred qualifications:

• Relevant practical or internship experience (e.g., research assistant, teaching assistant, personal projects, etc.) with programming in either: C++, Java, Python or Go.

• Relevant practical or internship experience with one or more of the following: AI/ML, infrastructure, web application development, Unix/Linux, mobile application development, distributed and parallel systems, machine learning, information retrieval, natural language processing, networking, developing large software systems, or security software development.

• Interest and ability to learn other coding languages as needed.

• Ability to complete a 13-17 week full-time internship in the internship location starting in either May, June or July 2027.

• Currently enrolled in your penultimate/final year of education.

About the job
 Please include your expected graduation date (month and year), and availability for the internship on your resume. The specific team and project(s) will be determined based on your educational background, interest and skills.
We offer a range of internships in either Software Engineering or Site-Reliability Engineering across EMEA. Durations and start dates will vary according to project and location. Our recruitment team will determine where you fit best based on your resume.

As an Intern, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs. Google is working to advance the state of the art in computing and build the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we work on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers. Whether we're shaping the future of sustainability, optimizing algorithms, or pioneering AI systems, our teams strive to continuously progress science, advance society, and improve the lives of billions of people.

Software Engineering Intern:
As a key member of a versatile team, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs. We need our engineers to be versatile, and enthusiastic in addressing new problems as we continue to push technology forward. You will design, test, deploy and maintain software solutions as you grow and evolve during your internship.

Site Reliability Intern:
Our engineers create, fix, extend and scale the code to keep it working and to harden it against all the bad actors of the internet. We drive reliability and performance on a massive scale. You will work on software development projects to keep important business-critical systems up and running, from code-level troubleshooting of traffic anomalies to maintenance of our services; from monitoring and alerts to building new automation infrastructure. Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.
 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
 [Bachelor's degree]

• France: €53000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Germany: €68500 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Ireland: €61000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Sweden: kr545000 (SEK) + 0% bonus target
 [Master's degree]

• France: €54000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Germany: €71000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Ireland: €62500 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

• Sweden: kr560000 (SEK) + 0% bonus target
 Learn more about benefits at Google .

Responsibilities

• Create and support a productive and innovative team including working with peers, managers and teams.

• Develop scripts to automate routine tasks.

• Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution to effectively solve problems.

• Apply knowledge gained in computer science courses to real world problems.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• Experience with data analysis and signal quality testing.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with large-scale data processing pipelines.

• Experience with data analysis and statistical thinking enabling you to rigorously evaluate metrics, tune algorithms and make data-motivated decisions.

• Experience designing clean Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and interfaces that integrate cleanly with multiple upstream services.

• Familiarity or strong interest in signal processing, machine learning frameworks or biometric classification workflows.

• Strong code health advocacy, with experience writing comprehensive integration tests for complex logical state machines.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The team is the central decision engine for Content ID, YouTube’s world-leading rights management platform. The team builds and operates the complex, real-time pipeline that orchestrates a suite of upstream signals from classic audio/visual fingerprinting to facial, speech and generative biometrics (e.g., LikenessID), as well as complex fictional and universe tracking (e.g., CharacterID). The team computes the authoritative, final claiming verdicts at a massive scale.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
 Responsibilities

• Leverage multi-modal signals (e.g., visual/audio/melody matching) to generate highly accurate content claims.

• Identify unauthorized Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) reuse of human likeness (e.g., facial/voice), animated characters and fictional universes alongside classical copyright.

• Detect Content ID bypass tricks and identify bad references used for illicit monetization while protecting innocent creators.

• Build, run and maintain both our core quality systems and the underlying infrastructure that powers them.

• Familiarità o forte interesse nell'elaborazione dei segnali, nei quadri di apprendimento automatico o nei flussi di lavoro di classificazione biometrica.

• Forte advocacy della salute del codice, con esperienza di scrittura di test di integrazione completi per macchine complesse di stato logico.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il team è il motore di decisione centrale per Content ID, piattaforma di gestione dei diritti leader mondiale di YouTube. Il team costruisce e gestisce la complessa pipeline in tempo reale che orchestra una suite di segnali a monte dalla classica impronta audio/visiva alla biometrica facciale, vocale e generativa (ad esempio, LikenessID), così come il tracciamento fittizio e universo complesso (ad esempio, CharacterID). Il team calcola l'autorevole e finale che rivendica i verdetti su larga scala.
Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.
responsabilità

• Leva segnali multi-modali (ad esempio, corrispondenza visiva/audio/melodia) per generare affermazioni di contenuti altamente accurate.

• Identificare il riutilizzo non autorizzato dell'intelligenza artificiale genetica (GenAI) della somiglianza umana (ad esempio, facciale/voce), personaggi animati e universi immaginari accanto al copyright classico.

• Rileva i trucchi di bypass dei contenuti e identifica i riferimenti cattivi utilizzati per la monetizzazione illecita proteggendo i creatori innocenti.

• Costruire, eseguire e mantenere sia i nostri sistemi di qualità di base e l'infrastruttura sottostante che li alimenta.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Das Team ist die zentrale Entscheidungsmaschine für Content ID, die weltweit führende Rechtemanagement-Plattform von YouTube. Das Team baut und betreibt die komplexe Echtzeit-Pipeline, die eine Reihe von Upstream-Signalen von klassischem Audio- / visuellem Fingerabdruck bis hin zu Gesichts-, Sprach- und generativer Biometrie (z. B. LikenessID) sowie komplexer fiktionaler und universeller Verfolgung orchestriert (z. B. CharacterID). Das Team berechnet die maßgeblichen, endgültigen Urteile in großem Maßstab.
Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und sich dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Nutzen Sie multimodale Signale (z. B. Visual / Audio / Melody Matching), um hochgenaue Inhaltsansprüche zu erzeugen.

• Identifizieren Sie nicht autorisierte Generative Künstliche Intelligenz (GenAI) Wiederverwendung von menschlichem Abbild (z. B. Gesicht / Stimme), animierte Charaktere und fiktive Universen neben klassischem Urheberrecht.

• Erkennen Sie Content ID Umgehungstricks und identifizieren Sie schlechte Referenzen, die für illegale Monetarisierung verwendet werden, während Sie unschuldige Schöpfer schützen.

• Bauen, betreiben und pflegen Sie sowohl unsere Kernqualitätssysteme als auch die zugrunde liegende Infrastruktur, die sie antreibt.

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé.

• Expérience de l'analyse des données et des tests de qualité des signaux.

Titres préférés:

• 2 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• Expérience de travail avec des pipelines de traitement de données à grande échelle.

• Expérience avec l'analyse des données et la pensée statistique vous permettant d'évaluer rigoureusement les mesures, d'ajuster les algorithmes et de prendre des décisions motivées par les données.

• Expérience de la conception d'interfaces de programmation d'applications propres (API) et d'interfaces qui s'intègrent parfaitement à de multiples services en amont.

• Connaissance ou fort intérêt pour le traitement des signaux, les cadres d'apprentissage automatique ou les flux de travail de classification biométrique.

• Forte défense de code santé, avec l'expérience de rédaction de tests d'intégration complets pour les machines d'état logique complexes.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

L'équipe est le moteur central de décision pour Content ID, la plateforme YouTube de gestion des droits leader mondial. L'équipe construit et exploite le pipeline complexe en temps réel qui orchestre une suite de signaux en amont allant de l'empreinte visuelle/audio classique à la biométrie du visage, de la parole et de la génération (p. ex., LikenessID), ainsi qu'un suivi complexe de la fiction et de l'univers (p. ex., CharacterID). L'équipe calcule les verdicts faisant autorité et définitifs à grande échelle.
Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit quand nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble.
Responsabilités

• Tirer parti des signaux multimodal (p. ex., correspondance visuelle/audio/melody) pour générer des allégations de contenu très précises.

• Identifiez la réutilisation non autorisée de l'intelligence artificielle generative (GenAI) de la ressemblance humaine (p. ex. visage/voix), des personnages animés et des univers fictifs aux côtés du droit d'auteur classique.

• Détecter les astuces de contournement de Content ID et identifier les mauvaises références utilisées pour la monétisation illicite tout en protégeant les créateurs innocents.

• Construisez, exécutez et maintenez à la fois nos systèmes de qualité essentiels et l'infrastructure sous-jacente qui les alimente.

• 4 years of motion design experience in product design, UX design, or UX/UI animation.

• Experience in motion design related to physics, patterns, and visual design elements.

• Experience with Lottie or Bodymovin export workflows, JSON data structures, and the rendering limits of mobile and web frameworks (CSS/SVG/Canvas).

• Experience documenting motion values (e.g., easing, duration, choreography) into design tokens and component libraries.

• Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.

• 1 year of experience leading design projects.

• Experience designing motion for conversational AI, generative AI, or agentic workflows (shimmers, stateful transitions, contextual prompts).

• Proficiency with modern prototyping tools (Claude code, ProtoPie, Rive, Framer, or basic code/shaders).

• Working familiarity with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender) for generating dimensional assets and ambient lighting effects.

About the job
 At Google, we follow a simple but vital premise: "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Google’s Motion Designers collaborate with cross-functional partners to create desirable and relevant product experiences that consistently elevate the Google brand. They help people make sense of their world by choreographing experiences that feel fluid, natural, and informative.

Google User Experience (UX) is made up of multi-disciplinary teams of UX Designers, Researchers, Writers, Content Strategists, Program Managers, and Engineers: we care deeply about the people who use our products. The UX team plays an integral part in gathering insights about the attitudes, emotions, and behaviors of people who use our products to inspire and inform design. We collaborate closely with each other and with engineering and product management to create industry-leading products that deliver value for the people who use them, and for Google’s businesses.

As a Motion Designer, you’ll apply your passion for animation to simplify complex interactions and solve challenging design problems. You’ll help define and implement Google’s motion design language and you’ll think critically about how motion reinforces Google’s UX brand, enhances interactivity, and delights our users.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”

Responsibilities

• Define and implement the look and feel of Google products through motion design.

• Provide patterns, best practices and guidance on animation and transitions for different devices (such as TV, tablets, wearables, mobile, etc.) and platforms (such as web, Android, iOS, etc.).

• Create high quality design proposals and drive projects from concept to iterations and implementation.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.

• Proficiency with modern prototyping tools (Claude code, ProtoPie, Rive, Framer, or basic code/shaders).

• Working familiarity with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender) for generating dimensional assets and ambient lighting effects.

About the job
At Google, we follow a simple but vital premise: "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Google’s Motion Designers collaborate with cross-functional partners to create desirable and relevant product experiences that consistently elevate the Google brand. They help people make sense of their world by choreographing experiences that feel fluid, natural, and informative.

Google User Experience (UX) is made up of multi-disciplinary teams of UX Designers, Researchers, Writers, Content Strategists, Program Managers, and Engineers: we care deeply about the people who use our products. The UX team plays an integral part in gathering insights about the attitudes, emotions, and behaviors of people who use our products to inspire and inform design. We collaborate closely with each other and with engineering and product management to create industry-leading products that deliver value for the people who use them, and for Google’s businesses.

As a Motion Designer, you’ll apply your passion for animation to simplify complex interactions and solve challenging design problems. You’ll help define and implement Google’s motion design language and you’ll think critically about how motion reinforces Google’s UX brand, enhances interactivity, and delights our users.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”

• Define and implement the look and feel of Google products through motion design.

• Provide patterns, best practices and guidance on animation and transitions for different devices (such as TV, tablets, wearables, mobile, etc.) and platforms (such as web, Android, iOS, etc.).

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience with software development in C++.

• 5 years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale ML infrastructure and distributed systems.

• 3 years of experience with software design and architecture and technical leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience in one or more of the following: Java, Go, Python, Kotlin.

• Experience in performing in-depth "forensics" on distributed systems to root-cause complex failures across multiple languages and frameworks.

• Ability to drive product evolution through A/B testing and metric analysis.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Health mission is to empower people to live longer and healthier lives. As a software engineer on the Health and Home Infrastructure team in Zurich, you will build and maintain the software infrastructure that powers products relied on by millions of people in their daily lives.
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.
 Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance, low-latency platform services in C++ and Java that reliably serve millions of users.

• Develop robust distributed microservices and RPC-based architectures, specializing in real-time voice/audio processing and streaming protocols.

• Create and optimize ML pipelines, overseeing dataset management, data processing, and frameworks for model training, evaluation, and deployment.

• Perform root-cause complex failures across multi-service environments, establish robust architectural guardrails, and lead data-driven change management using A/B testing, log analysis, and metrics.

• Collaborate directly with internal developers and end-users to identify friction points, author clear technical design documents, and foster high-alignment engineering discussions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Qualifiche minime:

• Laurea triennale o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software in C .

• 5 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, realizzazione e gestione di infrastrutture ML e sistemi distribuiti su larga scala.

• 3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione e architettura del software e leadership tecnica.

Qualifiche preferite:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria, informatica o settore tecnico correlato.

• 8 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• Esperienza in uno o più dei seguenti: Java, Go, Python, Kotlin.

• Esperienza nell'esecuzione di "analisi forensi" approfondite su sistemi distribuiti per individuare le cause di guasti complessi in più linguaggi e framework.

• Capacità di guidare l'evoluzione del prodotto attraverso test A/B e analisi metriche.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di prossima generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e tra loro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire informazioni su vasta scala e estendersi ben oltre la ricerca sul Web. Cerchiamo ingegneri che portino nuove idee da tutte le aree, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, elaborazione distribuita, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e archiviazione dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, progettazione dell'interfaccia utente e dispositivi mobili; l'elenco continua e cresce ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico fondamentale per le esigenze di Google con l'opportunità di cambiare team e progetto man mano che tu e la nostra frenetica attività crescete ed evolvete. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi a tutto campo mentre continuiamo a portare avanti la tecnologia.

La missione della Salute è consentire alle persone di vivere una vita più lunga e più sana. In qualità di ingegnere del software nel team Health and Home Infrastructure di Zurigo, costruirai e manterrai l'infrastruttura software che alimenta i prodotti su cui fanno affidamento milioni di persone nella loro vita quotidiana.
Il team Piattaforme e dispositivi comprende le varie piattaforme software informatiche di Google in tutti gli ambienti (desktop, dispositivi mobili, applicazioni), nonché i nostri dispositivi e servizi proprietari che combinano il meglio dell'intelligenza artificiale, del software e dell'hardware di Google. I team di quest'area ricercano, progettano e sviluppano nuove tecnologie per rendere l'interazione dei nostri utenti con l'informatica più rapida e fluida, costruendo esperienze innovative per i nostri utenti in tutto il mondo.
Responsabilità

• Progettare, realizzare e gestire servizi di piattaforma ad alte prestazioni e a bassa latenza in C e Java che servano in modo affidabile milioni di utenti.

• Sviluppare robusti microservizi distribuiti e architetture basate su RPC, specializzati nell'elaborazione voce/audio in tempo reale e nei protocolli di streaming.

• Creare e ottimizzare pipeline di ML, supervisionando la gestione dei set di dati, l'elaborazione dei dati e i framework per l'addestramento, la valutazione e la distribuzione dei modelli.

• Individuare le cause principali di guasti complessi in ambienti multiservizio, stabilire robusti guardrail architettonici e guidare la gestione delle modifiche basata sui dati utilizzando test A/B, analisi dei log e metriche.

• Collaborare direttamente con gli sviluppatori interni e gli utenti finali per identificare i punti di attrito, creare documenti di progettazione tecnica chiari e promuovere discussioni ingegneristiche di alto allineamento.

Nous avons besoin que nos ingénieurs soient polyvalents, fassent preuve de qualités de leadership et soient enthousiastes à l'idée de résoudre de nouveaux problèmes dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise tout en continuant à faire progresser la technologie.

La mission Santé est de donner aux gens les moyens de vivre plus longtemps et en meilleure santé. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel au sein de l'équipe Health and Home Infrastructure à Zurich, vous construirez et entretiendrez l'infrastructure logicielle qui alimente les produits sur lesquels comptent des millions de personnes dans leur vie quotidienne.
L'équipe Plateformes et appareils englobe les différentes plates-formes logicielles informatiques de Google dans tous les environnements (ordinateur de bureau, mobile, applications), ainsi que nos appareils et services propriétaires qui combinent le meilleur de l'IA, des logiciels et du matériel de Google. Les équipes de ce domaine recherchent, conçoivent et développent de nouvelles technologies pour rendre l'interaction de nos utilisateurs avec l'informatique plus rapide et plus transparente, créant ainsi des expériences innovantes pour nos utilisateurs du monde entier.
Responsabilités

• Concevoir, construire et maintenir des services de plateforme hautes performances et à faible latence en C et Java qui servent de manière fiable des millions d'utilisateurs.

• Développer des microservices distribués robustes et des architectures basées sur RPC, spécialisés dans le traitement voix/audio en temps réel et les protocoles de streaming.

• Créer et optimiser les pipelines ML, en supervisant la gestion des ensembles de données, le traitement des données et les cadres pour la formation, l'évaluation et le déploiement des modèles.

• Identifiez les causes profondes des pannes complexes dans des environnements multiservices, établissez des garde-fous architecturaux robustes et dirigez la gestion des changements basée sur les données à l'aide de tests A/B, d'analyses de journaux et de métriques.

• Collaborer directement avec les développeurs internes et les utilisateurs finaux pour identifier les points de friction, rédiger des documents de conception technique clairs et favoriser des discussions d'ingénierie de haut niveau.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering Connections

titleByLocale.en: Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering Connections
titleByLocale.it: Staff Software Ingegnere, Site Reliability Engineering Connections
titleByLocale.de: Staff Software Ingenieur, Site Reliability Engineering Connections
titleByLocale.fr: Staff Software Ingénieur, Site Reliability Engineering Connections

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.

• 3 years of experience leading projects.

• 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

• Experience with distributed and parallel systems.

• Strong preference toward consistent and common solutions over custom solutions.

• Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.

About the job
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.
 Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

In this role, you will be a part of the team responsible for finding ways to improve the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of these and other systems that billions of people across the world use every day that make their lives better.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

• Engage in and improve the whole life-cycle of services—from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.

• Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.

• Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.

• Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.

• Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Full Stack, Retail Advertiser Intelligence

titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere III, Full Stack, Retail Advertiser Intelligence
titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer III, Full Stack, Retail Advertiser Intelligence
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur III, Full Stack, Retail Advertiser Intelligence
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de logiciel III, Complet Stack, Revendeur Intelligence

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures or algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience working with large scale infrastructure and data processing pipelines.

• Experience in data processing, aggregation and reporting.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
As part of the Retail Advertiser Intelligence, you will be developing and maintaining infrastructure that powers products providing retailers with the reporting insights they need to make investment decisions, debug their performance and understand Google's competitiveness.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
 Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain the core reporting infrastructure: RVL, UDFs, Reporting Servers, Dynamo.

• Work with PM and UX to understand product requirements and develop the features.

• Part of oncall rotations, and keeping the system healthy.

• Design and improve advertiser experience latency.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Qualifiche minime:

• Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo completo dello stack, attraverso back-end come Java, Python, Golang, o C++ codebases, e l'esperienza front-end tra cui JavaScript o TypeScript, HTML, CSS o equivalente.

Qualificazioni preferite:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici connessi.

• 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati o algoritmi.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

• Esperienza nel lavoro con infrastrutture su larga scala e condotte di elaborazione dati.

• Esperienza nell'elaborazione, aggregazione e reporting dei dati.

I nostri prodotti devono gestire informazioni su larga scala e andare ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portino idee nuove da tutti i settori, tra cui il recupero delle informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione di linguaggi naturali, il design di UI e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per Google.s esigenze con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti come voi e la nostra azienda veloce-paced crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno dei nostri ingegneri per essere il body, mostrare qualità di leadership e essere entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la grotta come continuiamo a spingere la tecnologia avanti.

Come parte della Retail Advertiser Intelligence, si sta sviluppando e mantenendo l'infrastruttura che alimenta i prodotti che forniscono ai rivenditori con le informazioni di reporting che hanno bisogno di prendere decisioni di investimento, debug loro prestazioni e capire la competitività di Google.

Google Ads è all'avanguardia nell'innovazione AI, applicando modelli di apprendimento automatico all'avanguardia e Generative AI come Gemini per alimentare un business globale da più miliardi di dollari.

Il nostro lavoro ha un impatto diretto su miliardi di utenti, proteggendo gli utenti dai danni, migliorando la qualità degli annunci e ottimizzando le campagne per il ritorno degli inserzionisti su investimenti. Promuoviamo una cultura di profonda collaborazione, collaborando a stretto contatto con team come Google Research e DeepMind per risolvere sfide complesse. Unisciti a noi per lavorare su AI all'avanguardia, affrontare problemi a scala senza precedenti e costruire la nuova generazione di tecnologia pubblicitaria.

• Sviluppare e mantenere l'infrastruttura di reporting principale: RVL, UDF, Reporting Server, Dynamo.

• Lavorare con PM e UX per comprendere i requisiti del prodotto e sviluppare le caratteristiche.

• Parte delle rotazioni di guardia, e mantenere il sistema sano.

• Progettare e migliorare l'esperienza di inserzionista latenza.

Über den Job Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion von Milliarden von Benutzern mit Informationen und einander ändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen, und weit über die Websuche hinaus. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen, einschließlich Informationsbeschaffung, verteilte Computer, großformatige Systemdesign, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und mobile bringen; die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen, für Google kritischen Projekt, das mit Möglichkeiten zum Umschalten von Teams und Projekten auf Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wächst und sich entwickelt. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu bewältigen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Als Teil der Retail Advertiser Intelligence werden Sie die Infrastruktur entwickeln und pflegen, die Produkte befähigt, Einzelhändlern die notwendigen Informationen zu geben, um Investitionsentscheidungen zu treffen, ihre Leistung zu debuggen und die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Google zu verstehen.

Google Ads ist an der Spitze der KI-Innovation, die Anwendung modernster maschineller Lern-und Generative KI-Modelle wie Zwillinge, um ein Multi-B-Millionen-Dollar-Globalgeschäft.

Unsere Arbeit beeinflusst direkt Milliarden von Nutzern durch den Schutz von Nutzern vor Schaden, Verbesserung der Anzeigenqualität und Optimierung von Kampagnen für Werbetreibende Rückkehr-on-Investment. Wir fördern eine Kultur der tiefen Zusammenarbeit, die enge Partnerschaft mit Teams wie Google Research und DeepMind, um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen. Begleiten Sie uns, um an der State-of-the-Art-KI zu arbeiten, Probleme in einem unvergleichlichen Ausmaß zu nehmen und die nächste Generation von Werbetechnologie aufzubauen.

• Entwicklung und Pflege der Kern-Reporting-Infrastruktur: RVL, UDFs, Reporting Servers, Dynamo.

• Arbeiten Sie mit PM und UX, um die Produktanforderungen zu verstehen und die Funktionen zu entwickeln.

• Teil der Bereitschaftsdrehungen und die Erhaltung des Systems.

• Design und Verbesserung der Werbetreibenden Erfahrung Latency.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour Google, les besoins avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à main que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

• 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

• 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership.

• Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience balancing consumer reach with infrastructure constraints (cost, latency, and model optimization).

• Experience in cross-functional leadership, and partnering with teams across organizational boundaries.

• Familiarity with modern machine learning, LLMs, and foundational models (such as Gemini).

About the job
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In the AI era, users expect Search to effortlessly Answer, Explore, and Address Anything. To meet these rising expectations, our models need the content.
 The Search Content Platform (SCP) team builds an AI-first content platform to deliver a comprehensive and trustworthy knowledge source. By acquiring third-party data and organizing disparate modalities—such as text, images, videos, and User-Generated Content—into a seamless whole, we make Search AI experiences rich, helpful, and performant.
 Our team's mission is to use AI to revolutionize how we acquire and organize third-party content. As the Group Product Manager for Content Acquisition and Identity, you will manage a team to define the future of Google Search content. You will collaborate with engineering teams in Zurich, Sao Paulo, and Mountain View, and represent the organization to key partners.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

• Lead the product goal, detailed platform requirements for a horizontal content acquisition platform that accelerates third-party (3P) content acquisition while delivering on critical priority verticals such as Sports and Health.

• Enable Search to answer billions of user queries daily by innovating on content identity for the AI era and establishing clear, disambiguated, and precise identities for billions of user queries on Search daily.

• Direct efforts to analyze billions of current and aspirational user queries that lack sufficient content, and prioritize or drive initiatives to bridge these gaps and improve product helpfulness to end users.

• Discuss your knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process to demonstrate the AI fluency expected in this role.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti o un ruolo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza che prendono prodotti tecnici dal concepimento al lancio (ad esempio, ideazione all'esecuzione, end-to-end, 0 a 1, ecc).

• 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle persone, con leadership tecnica.

• Esperienza di integrare gli strumenti generativi AI o le interfacce LLM in flussi di lavoro.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza di bilanciamento della portata dei consumatori con vincoli di infrastruttura (costo, latenza e ottimizzazione dei modelli).

• Esperienza nella leadership interfunzionale e collaborazione con team attraverso i confini organizzativi.

• Familiarità con l'apprendimento automatico moderno, LLM e modelli fondamentali (come Gemini).

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, mettiamo i nostri utenti prima. Il mondo cambia sempre, quindi abbiamo bisogno di Product Manager che si adattano continuamente ed emozionano a lavorare su prodotti che colpiscono milioni di persone ogni giorno.

In questo ruolo, lavorerai trasversalmente per guidare i prodotti dal concepimento al lancio collegando i mondi tecnici e aziendali. È possibile abbattere problemi complessi in passi che guidano lo sviluppo del prodotto.

Uno dei tanti motivi per cui Google porta costantemente prodotti innovativi e mutevoli sul mercato è a causa del lavoro collaborativo che facciamo in Product Management. Il nostro team lavora a stretto contatto con ingegneri creativi, designer, marketers, ecc. per aiutare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di tecnologie che migliorano l'accesso alle informazioni del mondo. Siamo responsabili di guidare i prodotti durante tutto il ciclo di esecuzione, concentrandosi specificamente sull'analisi, il posizionamento, l'imballaggio, la promozione e la sartoria delle nostre soluzioni ai nostri utenti.

Nell'era dell'intelligenza artificiale, gli utenti si aspettano che la ricerca risponda senza sforzo, esplora e affronta qualsiasi cosa. Per soddisfare queste crescenti aspettative, i nostri modelli hanno bisogno del contenuto.
Il team Search Content Platform (SCP) costruisce una piattaforma di contenuti AI-first per fornire una fonte di conoscenza completa e affidabile. Con l'acquisizione di dati di terze parti e l'organizzazione di modalità disparate, come testo, immagini, video e Contenuti generati dall'utente, in un insieme senza soluzione di continuità, rendiamo le esperienze di Search AI ricche, utili e performanti.
La missione del nostro team è quella di utilizzare l'IA per rivoluzionare come acquisiamo e organizziamo contenuti di terze parti. Come Group Product Manager per l'acquisizione dei contenuti e l'identità, gestirai un team per definire il futuro dei contenuti di Google Search. Potrai collaborare con team di ingegneria a Zurigo, San Paolo e Mountain View, e rappresentare l'organizzazione per partner chiave.

In Google Search, stiamo rivisitando ciò che significa cercare informazioni – in qualsiasi modo e ovunque. Per farlo, abbiamo bisogno di risolvere complesse sfide ingegneristiche ed espandere la nostra infrastruttura, mantenendo un'esperienza universalmente accessibile e utile a cui le persone in tutto il mondo si affidano. Entrando nel team di ricerca, avrai l'opportunità di avere un impatto su miliardi di persone a livello globale.

responsabilità

• Condurre l'obiettivo del prodotto, i requisiti di piattaforma dettagliati per una piattaforma di acquisizione di contenuti orizzontale che accelera l'acquisizione di contenuti di terze parti (3P), offrendo al contempo verticali prioritari critici come Sport e Salute.

• Abilitare la ricerca per rispondere a miliardi di query utente al giorno innovando sull'identità dei contenuti per l'era dell'IA e stabilire identità chiare, disambiguate e precise per miliardi di domande degli utenti sulla ricerca quotidiana.

• Gli sforzi diretti per analizzare miliardi di domande attuali e ambiziose degli utenti che mancano di contenuti sufficienti, e priorizzare o guidare iniziative per colmare queste lacune e migliorare la disponibilità dei prodotti agli utenti finali.

• Discutete la vostra conoscenza e l'uso degli strumenti AI durante il processo di assunzione per dimostrare la fluidità AI prevista in questo ruolo.
