Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role.

• Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.

• Experience leading technical discovery sessions.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

• Experience identifying business problems and translating hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.

• Experience influencing and driving outcomes with cross-functional teams on engagements of high complexity and large scope and scale.

• Experience performing discovery interviews to identify business problems and translate hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.

• Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

About the job
 As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. Your role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset as you will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
 Responsibilities

• Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol. (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).

• Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.

• Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

• Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

• Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a relevant technical field with a focus on AI research, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in the full lifecycle of research modeling.

• Experience working with two or more of the following: advanced algorithms, machine learning, information retrieval, natural language processing, data science, distributed and parallel systems, developing software systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Ability to solve exceptionally complex problems (e.g., math and programming competitions or developing novel algorithms).

• Exceptional hacking skills and ability to quickly prototype and iterate on complex systems.

• Passion for working on real problems, a determination to overcome obstacles, and the ability to work on any task to get the job done.

• Quick learner with strong analytical and coding skills.

• Willingness to learn multiple tools and codebases.

• Willingness to work on ambiguous, ill-defined problems, refining final goals as new information is learned.

About the job
 Our team consists of ICs, who work across project boundaries. We initiate, prototype, hack, partner, and co-lead numerous high-profile projects within GDM, Search, and beyond. Our work spans a range, including low-level algorithms and infrastructure, AI/ML modeling and ranking, fundamental research, and product development. We consistently mix SoTA research and practical engineering.
 Our team has been responsible for significant improvements in Search algorithms for multiple generations, creating the ranking and machine learning platform, inventing novel algorithms and model architectures, and much more.

This role involves developing novel algorithms and AI architectures, hacking and prototyping, and creating tools to solve the most challenging problems, from infrastructure to user-facing products.
 This role offers the opportunity to work on a wide array of challenging problems and cutting-edge fundamental research while directly applying solutions to Google, making a significant impact on Google users.
 Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
 We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

• Develop a wide range of solutions, spanning from modeling to infrastructure (e.g., storing new knowledge, efficiently using LLMs to evaluate thousands of requests, improving those models, and enhancing their intelligence).

• Work with multiple codebases and machine learning libraries, creating numerous throwaway models and prototypes, as well as reusable model architectures and advanced libraries.

• Work in the context of real applications for important Google products and in partnership with product teams and other research engineers.

• Develop novel and practical solutions for AI and AI-powered tools. Expect to work on ambiguous, ill-defined problems, move quickly, iterate rapidly, and handle complex problems and codebases.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea in Informatica, un campo tecnico rilevante con un focus sulla ricerca AI, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nel ciclo di vita completo della modellazione di ricerca.

• Esperienza di lavoro con due o più dei seguenti: algoritmi avanzati, apprendimento automatico, recupero di informazioni, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, scienza dei dati, sistemi distribuiti e paralleli, sviluppo di sistemi software.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Capacità di risolvere problemi eccezionalmente complessi (ad esempio, concorsi di matematica e programmazione o sviluppo di algoritmi nuovi).

• Eccezionale capacità di hacking e capacità di prototipo rapidamente e iterare su sistemi complessi.

• Passione per lavorare su problemi reali, la determinazione a superare gli ostacoli, e la capacità di lavorare su qualsiasi compito per ottenere il lavoro fatto.

• Imparente veloce con forti capacità analitiche e di codifica.

• Volontà di imparare più strumenti e codebases.

• La volontà di lavorare su problemi ambigui e mal definiti, rifinanziando gli obiettivi finali come si imparano nuove informazioni.

Riguardo al lavoro
Il nostro team è composto da IC, che lavorano attraverso i confini del progetto. Iniziamo, prototipi, hack, partner e co-periamo numerosi progetti di alto profilo all'interno di GDM, Ricerca e oltre. Il nostro lavoro abbraccia una gamma, tra cui algoritmi di basso livello e infrastrutture, modellazione AI/ML e ranking, ricerca fondamentale e sviluppo del prodotto. Mescoliamo costantemente la ricerca SoTA e l'ingegneria pratica.
Il nostro team è stato responsabile di miglioramenti significativi negli algoritmi di ricerca per più generazioni, creando la piattaforma di graduatoria e machine learning, inventando nuovi algoritmi e architetture di modelli, e molto altro ancora.

Questo ruolo comporta lo sviluppo di nuovi algoritmi e architetture AI, hacking e prototipazione, e la creazione di strumenti per risolvere i problemi più impegnativi, dall'infrastruttura ai prodotti user-facing.
Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di lavorare su una vasta gamma di problemi impegnativi e di ricerca fondamentale all'avanguardia, applicando direttamente soluzioni a Google, rendendo un impatto significativo sugli utenti di Google.
L’intelligenza artificiale sarà una delle invenzioni più trasformative dell’umanità. A Google DeepMind, siamo un laboratorio AI pionieristico con team interdisciplinari eccezionali focalizzati sull'avanzamento dello sviluppo AI per risolvere complesse sfide globali e accelerare l'innovazione di prodotto di alta qualità per miliardi di utenti. Utilizziamo le nostre tecnologie per un ampio beneficio pubblico e una scoperta scientifica, assicurando la sicurezza e l'etica sono sempre la nostra massima priorità.
Stiamo spingendo i confini attraverso più domini. I nostri team globali offrono diverse opportunità di apprendimento e percorsi di carriera diversificati per coloro che sono spinti a raggiungere risultati eccezionali attraverso lo sforzo collettivo.

responsabilità

• Sviluppare una vasta gamma di soluzioni, che spaziano dalla modellazione alle infrastrutture (ad esempio, memorizzare nuove conoscenze, utilizzare in modo efficiente LLM per valutare migliaia di richieste, migliorare questi modelli e migliorare la loro intelligenza).

• Lavora con più basi di codice e librerie di apprendimento automatico, creando numerosi modelli e prototipi di lancio, così come architetture di modelli riutilizzabili e librerie avanzate.

• Lavorare nel contesto di applicazioni reali per importanti prodotti Google e in collaborazione con team di prodotti e altri ingegneri di ricerca.

• Sviluppare soluzioni innovative e pratiche per gli strumenti AI e AI-powered. Aspettatevi di lavorare su problemi ambigui, mal definiti, muoversi rapidamente, iterare rapidamente e gestire problemi complessi e codebases.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a relevant technical field with a focus on AI research, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in the full lifecycle of research modeling.

• Experience working with two or more of the following: advanced algorithms, machine learning, information retrieval, natural language processing, data science, distributed and parallel systems, developing software systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Ability to solve exceptionally complex problems (e.g., math and programming competitions or developing novel algorithms).

• Exceptional hacking skills and ability to quickly prototype and iterate on complex systems.

• Passion for working on real problems, a determination to overcome obstacles, and the ability to work on any task to get the job done.

• Quick learner with strong analytical and coding skills.

• Willingness to learn multiple tools and codebases.

• Willingness to work on ambiguous, ill-defined problems, refining final goals as new information is learned.

About the job
Our team consists of ICs, who work across project boundaries. We initiate, prototype, hack, partner, and co-lead numerous high-profile projects within GDM, Search, and beyond. Our work spans a range, including low-level algorithms and infrastructure, AI/ML modeling and ranking, fundamental research, and product development. We consistently mix SoTA research and practical engineering.
Our team has been responsible for significant improvements in Search algorithms for multiple generations, creating the ranking and machine learning platform, inventing novel algorithms and model architectures, and much more.

This role involves developing novel algorithms and AI architectures, hacking and prototyping, and creating tools to solve the most challenging problems, from infrastructure to user-facing products.
This role offers the opportunity to work on a wide array of challenging problems and cutting-edge fundamental research while directly applying solutions to Google, making a significant impact on Google users.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

• Develop a wide range of solutions, spanning from modeling to infrastructure (e.g., storing new knowledge, efficiently using LLMs to evaluate thousands of requests, improving those models, and enhancing their intelligence).

• Work with multiple codebases and machine learning libraries, creating numerous throwaway models and prototypes, as well as reusable model architectures and advanced libraries.

• Work in the context of real applications for important Google products and in partnership with product teams and other research engineers.

• Develop novel and practical solutions for AI and AI-powered tools. Expect to work on ambiguous, ill-defined problems, move quickly, iterate rapidly, and handle complex problems and codebases.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, ein relevanter technischer Bereich mit Schwerpunkt KI-Forschung oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung im gesamten Lebenszyklus der Forschungsmodellierung.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit zwei oder mehr der folgenden: fortgeschrittene Algorithmen, maschinelles Lernen, Informationsabruf, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, Datenwissenschaft, verteilte und parallele Systeme, Entwicklung von Softwaresystemen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Fähigkeit, außergewöhnlich komplexe Probleme zu lösen (z. B. Mathematik- und Programmierwettbewerbe oder die Entwicklung neuartiger Algorithmen).

• Außergewöhnliche Hacking-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, schnell Prototypen und Iteration auf komplexen Systemen.

• Leidenschaft für die Arbeit an echten Problemen, die Entschlossenheit, Hindernisse zu überwinden, und die Fähigkeit, an jeder Aufgabe zu arbeiten, um die Arbeit zu erledigen.

• Schneller Lernender mit starken analytischen und Programmierkenntnissen.

• Bereitschaft, mehrere Tools und Codebasen zu erlernen.

• Bereitschaft, an mehrdeutigen, schlecht definierten Problemen zu arbeiten und endgültige Ziele zu verfeinern, wenn neue Informationen gelernt werden.

Über den Job
Unser Team besteht aus ICs, die über Projektgrenzen hinweg arbeiten. Wir initiieren, prototypisieren, hacken, kooperieren und leiten zahlreiche hochkarätige Projekte innerhalb von GDM, Search und darüber hinaus. Unsere Arbeit umfasst eine Reihe von Algorithmen und Infrastrukturen auf niedriger Ebene, AI / ML-Modellierung und -Ranking, Grundlagenforschung und Produktentwicklung. Wir mischen konsequent SoTA Forschung und praktisches Engineering.
Unser Team ist seit mehreren Generationen für signifikante Verbesserungen der Suchalgorithmen, die Erstellung der Ranking- und Machine-Learning-Plattform, die Erfindung neuartiger Algorithmen und Modellarchitekturen und vieles mehr verantwortlich.

Diese Rolle umfasst die Entwicklung neuartiger Algorithmen und KI-Architekturen, Hacking und Prototyping sowie die Schaffung von Tools zur Lösung der schwierigsten Probleme, von der Infrastruktur bis hin zu benutzerorientierten Produkten.
Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, an einer Vielzahl herausfordernder Probleme und innovativer Grundlagenforschung zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig Lösungen direkt auf Google anzuwenden, was erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Google-Nutzer hat.
Künstliche Intelligenz wird eine der transformativsten Erfindungen der Menschheit sein. Bei Google DeepMind sind wir ein wegweisendes KI-Labor mit außergewöhnlichen interdisziplinären Teams, die sich darauf konzentrieren, die KI-Entwicklung voranzutreiben, um komplexe globale Herausforderungen zu lösen und qualitativ hochwertige Produktinnovationen für Milliarden von Nutzern zu beschleunigen. Wir nutzen unsere Technologien für den breiten öffentlichen Nutzen und wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen, Sicherheit und Ethik sind immer unsere höchste Priorität.
Wir verschieben die Grenzen über mehrere Domänen hinweg. Unsere globalen Teams bieten vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und vielfältige Karrierewege für diejenigen, die durch gemeinsame Anstrengungen außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielen wollen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Entwicklung einer breiten Palette von Lösungen, die von der Modellierung bis zur Infrastruktur reichen (z. B. Speicherung neuen Wissens, effiziente Nutzung von LLMs zur Bewertung von Tausenden von Anfragen, Verbesserung dieser Modelle und Verbesserung ihrer Intelligenz).

• Arbeiten Sie mit mehreren Codebasen und maschinellen Lernbibliotheken und erstellen Sie zahlreiche Wegwerfmodelle und Prototypen sowie wiederverwendbare Modellarchitekturen und erweiterte Bibliotheken.

• Arbeiten Sie im Kontext realer Anwendungen für wichtige Google-Produkte und in Partnerschaft mit Produktteams und anderen Forschungsingenieuren.

• Entwicklung neuartiger und praktischer Lösungen für KI und KI-basierte Tools. Erwarten Sie, dass Sie an mehrdeutigen, schlecht definierten Problemen arbeiten, sich schnell bewegen, schnell iterieren und komplexe Probleme und Codebasen bearbeiten.

Nous utilisons nos technologies à des fins d'intérêt général et de découverte scientifique, en veillant à ce que la sécurité et l'éthique soient toujours notre priorité absolue.
Nous repoussons les frontières entre plusieurs domaines. Nos équipes mondiales offrent diverses possibilités d'apprentissage et des parcours de carrière variés pour ceux qui sont motivés par des résultats exceptionnels grâce à des efforts collectifs.

• Travaillez avec de multiples bases de code et bibliothèques d'apprentissage automatique, créant de nombreux modèles et prototypes, ainsi que des architectures de modèles réutilisables et des bibliothèques avancées.

• Travailler dans le contexte d'applications réelles pour des produits importants Google et en partenariat avec des équipes de produits et d'autres ingénieurs de recherche.

• Élaborer des solutions nouvelles et pratiques pour les outils de l'IA et de l'IA. S'attendre à travailler sur des problèmes ambigus et mal définis, se déplacer rapidement, itérer rapidement, et gérer des problèmes complexes et des bases de code.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

• 5 of experience in software development, and with data structures/algorithms.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

• 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 2 years of hardware design experience.

• Familiarity with hardware EDA tools.

About the job
 At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

At DeepMind, you’ll have the opportunity to revolutionise AI by applying AI to chip design. We develop research breakthroughs that impact all aspects of the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) process, to significantly reduce the time to market of Google’s products and services.
 Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
 We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and optimize software tools to improve the quality of generated RTL and accelerate the execution of hardware compilation and EDA tools.

• Profile, identify, and resolve performance bottlenecks in software tools to speed up optimization and synthesis cycles.

• Collaborate with hardware architects, compiler engineers, and ML researchers to bridge the gap between high-level representations and highly optimized RTL.

• Develop robust, scalable automation scripts and software libraries to streamline and speed up RTL generation and optimization workflows.

• Work with product engineering teams to bring the software tools we are developing to production quality.

• 5 di esperienza nello sviluppo del software, e con strutture di dati/algoritmi.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o in campo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 2 anni di esperienza nella progettazione hardware.

• Familiarità con strumenti hardware EDA.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google DeepMind la nostra missione è quella di costruire il primo agente di apprendimento generale del mondo. Centrale a questa missione è il complesso compito di misurare l'intelligenza dei nostri prototipi. Come Ingegnere di Software, lavorerai con gli agenti AI all'avanguardia sviluppati dal nostro eccezionale team di scienziati di ricerca di Machine Learning e Neuroscience. Le tue responsabilità includono tutto, dalla creazione di sistemi per test di agente utilizzando giochi 2D e 3D per lo sviluppo di problemi di test all'interno dei simulatori di fisica. Si creerà la visualizzazione grafica dei risultati, costruire classifiche di agenti competitivi e testare nuovi algoritmi sui robot. Per avere successo in questo ruolo è necessario avere una solida base nell'ingegneria del software e godere di lavorare su una vasta gamma di problemi impegnativi all'interno di un team guidato dalla missione.

A DeepMind, avrete l'opportunità di rivoluzionare l'IA applicando l'IA al design chip. Sviluppiamo innovazioni di ricerca che influenzano tutti gli aspetti del processo di Electronic Design Automation (EDA), per ridurre significativamente il tempo di mercato dei prodotti e servizi di Google.
L’intelligenza artificiale sarà una delle invenzioni più trasformative dell’umanità. A Google DeepMind, siamo un laboratorio AI pionieristico con team interdisciplinari eccezionali focalizzati sull'avanzamento dello sviluppo AI per risolvere complesse sfide globali e accelerare l'innovazione di prodotto di alta qualità per miliardi di utenti. responsabilità

• Progettare, sviluppare e ottimizzare gli strumenti software per migliorare la qualità della RTL generata e accelerare l'esecuzione della compilazione hardware e degli strumenti EDA.

• Profilo, identificare e risolvere i colli di bottiglia delle prestazioni negli strumenti software per accelerare i cicli di ottimizzazione e sintesi.

• Collabora con architetti hardware, ingegneri compilatori e ricercatori ML per colmare il divario tra rappresentazioni di alto livello e RTL altamente ottimizzato.

• Sviluppa script di automazione robusti e scalabili e librerie di software per ottimizzare e velocizzare i flussi di lavoro di generazione RTL e ottimizzazione.

• Lavora con i team di ingegneria del prodotto per portare gli strumenti software che stiamo sviluppando per la qualità di produzione.

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (z.B. Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

• 5 der Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und mit Datenstrukturen / Algorithmen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereich.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

• 2 Jahre Hardware-Design-Erfahrung.

• Vertrautheit mit Hardware-EDA-Tools.

Über den Job
Bei Google DeepMind ist es unsere Mission, den weltweit ersten universellen Lernagenten aufzubauen. Im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission steht die komplexe Aufgabe, die Intelligenz unserer Prototypen zu messen. Als Software Engineer arbeiten Sie mit hochmodernen KI-Agenten zusammen, die von unserem außergewöhnlichen Team aus Wissenschaftlern aus den Bereichen Machine Learning und Neurowissenschaften entwickelt wurden. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen alles, von der Erstellung von Systemen für Agententests mit 2D- und 3D-Spielen bis hin zur Entwicklung von Testproblemen in Physiksimulatoren. Sie erstellen eine grafische Visualisierung der Ergebnisse, erstellen Bestenlisten für Wettbewerbsagenten und testen neue Algorithmen an Robotern. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie eine starke Grundlage im Software-Engineering haben und Spaß daran haben, an einer Vielzahl von herausfordernden Problemen in einem missionsgesteuerten Team zu arbeiten.

Bei DeepMind haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die KI zu revolutionieren, indem Sie KI auf das Chipdesign anwenden. Wir entwickeln Forschungsdurchbrüche, die sich auf alle Aspekte des Electronic Design Automation (EDA)-Prozesses auswirken, um die Markteinführungszeit von Google-Produkten und -Diensten erheblich zu reduzieren.
Künstliche Intelligenz wird eine der transformativsten Erfindungen der Menschheit sein. Bei Google DeepMind sind wir ein wegweisendes KI-Labor mit außergewöhnlichen interdisziplinären Teams, die sich darauf konzentrieren, die KI-Entwicklung voranzutreiben, um komplexe globale Herausforderungen zu lösen und qualitativ hochwertige Produktinnovationen für Milliarden von Nutzern zu beschleunigen. Wir nutzen unsere Technologien für den breiten öffentlichen Nutzen und wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen, Sicherheit und Ethik sind immer unsere höchste Priorität.
Wir verschieben die Grenzen über mehrere Domänen hinweg. Unsere globalen Teams bieten vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und vielfältige Karrierewege für diejenigen, die durch gemeinsame Anstrengungen außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielen wollen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Entwerfen, entwickeln und optimieren Sie Software-Tools, um die Qualität der generierten RTL zu verbessern und die Ausführung von Hardware-Compilation- und EDA-Tools zu beschleunigen.

• Profilieren, identifizieren und beheben Sie Leistungsengpässe in Software-Tools, um Optimierungs- und Synthesezyklen zu beschleunigen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Hardware-Architekten, Compiler-Ingenieuren und ML-Forschern zusammen, um die Lücke zwischen hochrangigen Darstellungen und hochoptimiertem RTL zu schließen.

• Entwickeln Sie robuste, skalierbare Automatisierungsskripte und Softwarebibliotheken, um RTL-Generierungs- und Optimierungsworkflows zu optimieren und zu beschleunigen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Produktentwicklungsteams zusammen, um die von uns entwickelten Software-Tools in Produktionsqualität zu bringen.

• 5 d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels, et avec des structures de données/algorithmes.

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• 5 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• 2 ans d'expérience en conception de matériel.

• Familiarité avec les outils EDA matériels.

Sur le travail
Chez Google DeepMind, notre mission est de construire le premier agent d'apprentissage général au monde. La tâche complexe de mesurer l'intelligence de nos prototypes est au cœur de cette mission. En tant qu'ingénieur en logiciels, vous travaillerez avec les agents d'IA de pointe développés par notre équipe exceptionnelle de chercheurs en apprentissage automatique et en neurosciences. Vos responsabilités comprendront tout, de la création de systèmes pour les tests d'agents à l'aide de jeux 2D et 3D au développement de problèmes de test au sein des simulateurs de physique. Vous créerez une visualisation graphique des résultats, créerez des classements d'agents compétitifs et testerez de nouveaux algorithmes sur les robots. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin d'avoir une base solide en génie logiciel et profiter de travailler sur un large éventail de problèmes difficiles au sein d'une équipe axée sur la mission.

Chez DeepMind, vous aurez la possibilité de révolutionner l'IA en appliquant l'IA à la conception des puces. Nous développons des percées de recherche qui influent sur tous les aspects du processus d'automatisation de conception électronique (EDA), afin de réduire considérablement le temps pour le marché des produits et services Google.
L'intelligence artificielle sera l'une des inventions les plus transformatrices de l'humanité. Chez Google DeepMind, nous sommes un laboratoire d'IA pionnier avec des équipes interdisciplinaires exceptionnelles axées sur le développement de l'IA pour résoudre des défis mondiaux complexes et accélérer l'innovation de produits de haute qualité pour des milliards d'utilisateurs. Nous utilisons nos technologies à des fins d'intérêt général et de découverte scientifique, en veillant à ce que la sécurité et l'éthique soient toujours notre priorité absolue.
Nous repoussons les frontières entre plusieurs domaines. Nos équipes mondiales offrent diverses possibilités d'apprentissage et des parcours de carrière variés pour ceux qui sont motivés par des résultats exceptionnels grâce à des efforts collectifs.

Responsabilités

• Concevoir, développer et optimiser les outils logiciels pour améliorer la qualité de RTL généré et accélérer l'exécution de la compilation matérielle et des outils EDA.

• Profiler, identifier et résoudre les goulets d'étranglement dans les outils logiciels pour accélérer les cycles d'optimisation et de synthèse.

• Collaborer avec des architectes matériels, des ingénieurs compilateurs et des chercheurs en ML pour combler l'écart entre les représentations de haut niveau et RTL hautement optimisé.

• Développer des scripts d'automatisation robustes et évolutives et des bibliothèques logicielles pour rationaliser et accélérer les flux de production et d'optimisation de RTL.

• Travailler avec les équipes d'ingénierie de produits pour apporter les outils logiciels que nous développons à la qualité de production.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

• 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

• 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, marketing, legal and other stakeholders.

• Experience running and analyzing A/B tests.

• Experience working with UX/UI (Figma).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in a technology or business related field.

• 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.

• Experience working in building consumer products in the shopping/e-commerce industry.

• Experience/curiosity for incorporating accessibility into product development methodologies.

• Knowledge of, or continued interest in building accessibility best practices.

About the job
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Video commerce is revolutionizing the way that people decide what to buy and the way that creators make money across the globe.

Shopping on YouTube is one of Google’s top Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) because it represents a systemic shift in the platform with an opportunity to fundamentally change the way that creators monetize and the way that viewers interact with the content they watch.

Today, YouTube is partnering with some of the world's largest retailers and store builders to overlay products natively in videos. When viewers engage with these products creators make commission, earning money with minimal effort, while helping their audience discover products they love and decide what to buy.
 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

• Define and drive long-term growth for YouTube Shopping by designing and experimenting with experiences that enable viewers to watch and shop simultaneously.

• Own the end-to-end shopping journey, from initial product discovery in a video to the final checkout, constantly identifying and removing friction.

• Leverage complex datasets to identify growth opportunities and prioritize a roadmap based on potential Return on Investment (ROI) and user impact.

• Design, launch, and analyze rigorous A/B tests.

• Partner closely with UX Design, Engineering, and Data Science to turn ambiguous user needs into concrete product plans.

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti o un ruolo tecnico correlato.

• 2 anni di esperienza di lavoro cross-funzionale con ingegneria, UX/UI, marketing, legale e altri stakeholder.

• Esperienza di esecuzione e analisi dei test A/B.

• Esperienza di lavoro con UX/UI (Figma).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale in un campo tecnologico o commerciale.

• 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di preparazione e presentazione tecnica alla leadership executive.

• Esperienza di lavoro nella costruzione di prodotti di consumo nel settore dello shopping/e-commerce.

• Esperienza/curiosità per incorporare l'accessibilità nelle metodologie di sviluppo del prodotto.

• Conoscenza di, o continuo interesse per la costruzione delle migliori pratiche di accessibilità.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, mettiamo i nostri utenti prima. Il mondo cambia sempre, quindi abbiamo bisogno di Product Manager che si adattano continuamente ed emozionano a lavorare su prodotti che colpiscono milioni di persone ogni giorno.

In questo ruolo, lavorerai trasversalmente per guidare i prodotti dal concepimento al lancio collegando i mondi tecnici e aziendali. È possibile abbattere problemi complessi in passi che guidano lo sviluppo del prodotto.

Uno dei tanti motivi per cui Google porta costantemente prodotti innovativi e mutevoli sul mercato è a causa del lavoro collaborativo che facciamo in Product Management. Il nostro team lavora a stretto contatto con ingegneri creativi, designer, marketers, ecc. per aiutare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di tecnologie che migliorano l'accesso alle informazioni del mondo. Siamo responsabili di guidare i prodotti durante tutto il ciclo di esecuzione, concentrandosi specificamente sull'analisi, il posizionamento, l'imballaggio, la promozione e la sartoria delle nostre soluzioni ai nostri utenti.

Il Videocommercio sta rivoluzionando il modo in cui le persone decidono cosa comprare e il modo in cui i creatori fanno soldi in tutto il mondo.

Shopping su YouTube è uno dei migliori obiettivi di Google e risultati chiave (OKRs) perché rappresenta un cambiamento sistemico nella piattaforma con l'opportunità di cambiare fondamentalmente il modo in cui i creatori monetize e il modo in cui gli spettatori interagiscono con il contenuto che guardano.

Oggi, YouTube sta collaborando con alcuni dei più grandi rivenditori e costruttori di negozi al mondo per sovrapporre i prodotti nativamente in video. Quando gli spettatori si impegnano con questi creatori di prodotti fare commissioni, guadagnare soldi con il minimo sforzo, mentre aiutare il loro pubblico scoprire prodotti che amano e decidere cosa acquistare.
Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.

responsabilità

• Definire e guidare la crescita a lungo termine per YouTube Shopping progettando e sperimentando esperienze che permettono agli spettatori di guardare e fare acquisti contemporaneamente.

• Proprio il viaggio di shopping end-to-end, dalla scoperta iniziale del prodotto in un video al checkout finale, costantemente identificare e rimuovere l'attrito.

• Sfrutta i set di dati complessi per identificare le opportunità di crescita e priorità una roadmap basata sul potenziale Ritorno sugli Investimenti (ROI) e l'impatto dell'utente.

• Progettazione, lancio e analisi rigorosi test A/B.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con UX Design, Ingegneria e Data Science per trasformare le esigenze ambigue degli utenti in piani di prodotto concreti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder einer verwandten technischen Rolle.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung (z. B. Ideation bis zur Ausführung, End-to-End, 0 bis 1 usw.).

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der funktionsübergreifenden Arbeit mit Engineering, UX / UI, Marketing, Recht und anderen Stakeholdern.

• Erfahrung beim Ausführen und Analysieren von A / B-Tests.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit UX/UI (Figma).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss in einem Technologie- oder Geschäftsfeld.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Rolle Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung von technischen Präsentationen für Führungskräfte.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Konsumgütern in der Shopping / E-Commerce-Branche.

• Erfahrung/Neugier für die Einbeziehung der Zugänglichkeit in die Methoden der Produktentwicklung.

• Kenntnis oder anhaltendes Interesse am Aufbau bewährter Verfahren für Barrierefreiheit.

Über den Job
Bei Google stehen unsere Nutzer an erster Stelle. Die Welt verändert sich ständig, daher brauchen wir Produktmanager, die sich ständig anpassen und begeistert sind, an Produkten zu arbeiten, die jeden Tag Millionen von Menschen betreffen.

In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend, um Produkte von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung zu führen, indem Sie die technische und geschäftliche Welt verbinden. Sie können komplexe Probleme in Schritte unterteilen, die die Produktentwicklung vorantreiben.

Einer der vielen Gründe, warum Google konsequent innovative, weltverändernde Produkte auf den Markt bringt, ist die Zusammenarbeit im Produktmanagement. Unser Team arbeitet eng mit Kreativingenieuren, Designern, Vermarktern usw. zusammen, um Technologien zu entwerfen und zu entwickeln, die den Zugang zu den Informationen der Welt verbessern. Wir sind dafür verantwortlich, Produkte während des gesamten Ausführungszyklus zu führen, wobei wir uns speziell auf die Analyse, Positionierung, Verpackung, Förderung und Anpassung unserer Lösungen an unsere Benutzer konzentrieren.

Video-Commerce revolutioniert die Art und Weise, wie Menschen entscheiden, was sie kaufen und wie Schöpfer weltweit Geld verdienen.

Das Einkaufen auf YouTube ist eines der Top-Ziele und Schlüsselergebnisse (OKRs) von Google, da es einen systemischen Wandel in der Plattform darstellt, mit der Möglichkeit, die Art und Weise, wie Schöpfer monetarisieren, und die Art und Weise, wie Zuschauer mit den von ihnen angesehenen Inhalten interagieren, grundlegend zu verändern.

Heute arbeitet YouTube mit einigen der weltweit größten Einzelhändlern und Store Buildern zusammen, um Produkte nativ in Videos zu überlagern. Wenn Zuschauer mit diesen Produkten interagieren, machen die Schöpfer Provisionen, verdienen Geld mit minimalem Aufwand und helfen ihrem Publikum, Produkte zu entdecken, die sie lieben, und entscheiden, was sie kaufen sollen.
Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und sich dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Definieren und fördern Sie langfristiges Wachstum für YouTube Shopping, indem Sie Erlebnisse entwerfen und experimentieren, die es den Zuschauern ermöglichen, gleichzeitig zuzusehen und einzukaufen.

• Besitzen Sie die End-to-End-Shopping-Reise, von der ersten Produktentdeckung in einem Video bis zur endgültigen Kasse, um Reibungen ständig zu erkennen und zu beseitigen.

• Nutzen Sie komplexe Datensätze, um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren und eine Roadmap basierend auf dem potenziellen Return on Investment (ROI) und den Auswirkungen auf die Nutzer zu priorisieren.

• Entwerfen, starten und analysieren Sie strenge A/B-Tests.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit UX Design, Engineering und Data Science, um mehrdeutige Nutzerbedürfnisse in konkrete Produktpläne umzusetzen.

Sur le travail
Chez Google, nous mettons nos utilisateurs en premier. Le monde est en constante évolution, nous avons donc besoin de Product Managers qui s'adaptent continuellement et sont excités à travailler sur des produits qui affectent des millions de personnes chaque jour.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez interfonctionnellement pour guider les produits de la conception au lancement en reliant les mondes technique et commercial. Vous pouvez décomposer les problèmes complexes en étapes qui conduisent au développement de produits.

L'une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles Google apporte constamment des produits innovants et changeants sur le marché est le travail collaboratif que nous faisons dans la gestion des produits. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs créatifs, des concepteurs, des marketeurs, etc. pour aider à concevoir et développer des technologies qui améliorent l'accès à l'information mondiale. Nous sommes responsables de guider les produits tout au long du cycle d'exécution, en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse, le positionnement, l'emballage, la promotion et l'adaptation de nos solutions à nos utilisateurs.

Le commerce vidéo révolutionne la façon dont les gens décident quoi acheter et la façon dont les créateurs gagnent de l'argent à travers le monde.

Shopping sur YouTube est l'un des principaux objectifs et résultats clés de Google (OKR) car il représente un changement systémique dans la plate-forme avec une occasion de changer fondamentalement la façon dont les créateurs monétiser et la façon dont les téléspectateurs interagissent avec le contenu qu'ils regardent.

Aujourd'hui, YouTube s'associe avec certains des plus grands détaillants et constructeurs de magasins au monde pour superposer des produits nativement dans des vidéos. Lorsque les téléspectateurs s'engagent avec ces créateurs de produits font la commission, gagner de l'argent avec un minimum d'effort, tout en aidant leur public à découvrir des produits qu'ils aiment et décider quoi acheter.
Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit quand nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble.

Responsabilités

• Définir et stimuler la croissance à long terme pour YouTube Shopping en concevant et en expérimentant des expériences qui permettent aux téléspectateurs de regarder et de magasiner simultanément.

• Posséder le parcours d'achat de bout en bout, de la découverte initiale du produit dans une vidéo à la commande finale, en identifiant et en éliminant constamment les frictions.

• Mettre à profit des ensembles de données complexes pour identifier les possibilités de croissance et hiérarchiser une feuille de route fondée sur le rendement potentiel de l'investissement et l'impact des utilisateurs.

• Conception, lancement et analyse de tests rigoureux A/B.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• Experience with data analysis, business intelligence platform/SQL/database querying technologies.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Retail Campaign Management, Content and Automation team is a part of the Retail Advertiser Experiences (RAX) team, a cross-functional team in Zurich that's a part of the Shopping Ads org. Shopping Ads help consumers find the products they're looking for, and Ads in general power the open and free internet, allowing users worldwide to access useful services and information without paying for it.

Retail Ads are a significant source of business for Google, and our cross-functional group directly delivers value for our advertisers, growing Google Ads business in the process. Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
 Responsibilities

• Dive into new codebases to contribute across different parts of the Ads stack.

• Analyze data to understand feature usage and impact.

• Design, build, test, and launch features in collaboration with partner teams.

• Collaborate with Product Managers (PMs) to define the right scope for features we build.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience communicating to broad sets of stakeholders and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and firm sense of accountability, ownership for end-to-end project lifecycle.

About the job
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

Responsibilities

• Organize and manage the activities that lead to the outcomes of a project: what, who, when, and how. Adjust levers (e.g., schedule, staffing, features) to deliver results on time.

• Monitor and communicate progress, risks, and mitigations. Work closely with partner teams to manage program changes.

• Align stakeholders on decisions and changing circumstances.

• Manage the dependencies and deliverables with other related projects/teams and functions.

• Identify improvements and processes, products, or services on an ongoing basis through measurement of performance, progress, and success metrics.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 15 years of experience leading a research agenda.

• Experience in deep learning and experience with Python and neural network training.

• Experience training, evaluating, and interpreting large multimodal models and large language models.

• A publication record in machine learning conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, ICCV, ECCV).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in research leadership across organizations.

• Experience leading a diverse set of research scientists, research engineers, and software engineers.

About the job
 At DeepMind (GDM), we’re a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts, and more, working together to advance artificial intelligence. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring that safety and ethics are the highest priority.
 As a Research Scientist, you will utilize experience in foundational research, to expand the frontiers of artificial intelligence including driving the development of next-generation foundational AI architectures and frontier models. This will involve close collaboration with research scientists and software engineers across the globe, working to create AI models capable of integrating and reasoning across diverse modalities. You will work collaboratively to manage fundamental challenges in machine learning and AI, pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
 The team operates within the GDM Frontier AI unit, which is the engine of innovation for DeepMind, pioneering breakthrough research and collaborating across Alphabet to deliver real-world impact.
 Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
 We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

• Define and lead ambitious research projects, setting the technical direction and ensuring the successful execution of the research agenda.

• Design and implement innovative model architectures that effectively learn from diverse data modalities, complex environments, and structured datasets.

• Develop and establish benchmarks for evaluating frontier AI systems across diverse capabilities, reasoning tasks, and domains.

• Contribute to the overall research strategy of the team, identifying new research directions and influencing the broader research community through publications and presentations

• A publication record in machine learning conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, ICCV, ECCV).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in research leadership across organizations.

• Experience leading a diverse set of research scientists, research engineers, and software engineers.

About the job
At DeepMind (GDM), we’re a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts, and more, working together to advance artificial intelligence. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring that safety and ethics are the highest priority.
As a Research Scientist, you will utilize experience in foundational research, to expand the frontiers of artificial intelligence including driving the development of next-generation foundational AI architectures and frontier models. This will involve close collaboration with research scientists and software engineers across the globe, working to create AI models capable of integrating and reasoning across diverse modalities. You will work collaboratively to manage fundamental challenges in machine learning and AI, pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
The team operates within the GDM Frontier AI unit, which is the engine of innovation for DeepMind, pioneering breakthrough research and collaborating across Alphabet to deliver real-world impact.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

• Define and lead ambitious research projects, setting the technical direction and ensuring the successful execution of the research agenda.

• Design and implement innovative model architectures that effectively learn from diverse data modalities, complex environments, and structured datasets.

• Develop and establish benchmarks for evaluating frontier AI systems across diverse capabilities, reasoning tasks, and domains.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development.

• 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

• 5 years of experience in computer vision and machine learning, with specialized focus in one or more of the below areas: 3D computer vision, multimodal learning, and scene/object understanding.

• Experience in an industry or advanced research setting acting as a technical lead or equivalent, driving the complete research-to-product pipeline.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience designing and prototyping augmented or virtual reality products.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Semantic Perception team, part of Google XR, develops innovative core tech around computer vision and machine learning, in particular scene and object understanding, 3D computer vision, multimodal learning. The activity spans the whole range from research to product. The team is composed of Research Scientists and Software Engineers experts in the field. The team serves multiple perception-related products at Google, with a particular focus on XR products and applications.
For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by
breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where
lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.
 Responsibilities

• Research, develop, and deliver computer vision and machine learning technologies for augmented and mixed reality platforms.

• Act as a subject matter expert in taking Computer Vision/Machine Learning (CV/ML) models from research prototypes to production, focusing on mobile framework integration, edge optimization, and runtime robustness.

• Serve as tech lead across critical XR feature tracks, guiding multidisciplinary teams of software engineers and research scientists from scoping through release.

• Partner effectively with product, UX, and program management, while maintaining proactive alignment with executive leadership and key stakeholders across the engineering organization.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titoli minimi

- Laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente. - 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software. - 5 anni di esperienza nel testing, e il lancio di prodotti software, e 3 anni di esperienza con il design software e l'architettura. - 5 anni di esperienza in visione informatica e apprendimento automatico, con focus specializzato in uno o più dei seguenti settori: visione 3D del computer, apprendimento multimodale, e comprensione scena/oggetto. - Esperienza in un settore o ambiente di ricerca avanzata che agisce come un vantaggio tecnico o equivalente, guidando la completa pipeline di ricerca-prodotto.

Qualificazioni preferite

- Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica, Robotica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o una disciplina tecnica correlata. - Esperienza nella progettazione e nella prototipazione di prodotti di realtà aumentata o virtuale.

Riguardo il lavoro

I tecnici software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con l'informazione e l'altro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e si estendono ben oltre la ricerca web. Stiamo cercando ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui recupero delle informazioni, calcolo distribuito, progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, networking e memorizzazione dei dati, sicurezza, intelligenza artificiale, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, design e mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno.

Come ingegnere software, lavorerete su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre voi e il nostro business fast-paced crescono ed evolveranno. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership ed entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutta la stack mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il team Semantic Perception, parte di Google XR, sviluppa tecnologie innovative di core tech relative alla visione informatica e all'apprendimento automatico, in particolare la comprensione di scene e oggetti, la visione 3D, l'apprendimento multimodale. L'attività spazia dall'intera gamma di ricerca al prodotto. Il team è composto da esperti di Ricerca Scienziati e Software Engineers. Il team serve più prodotti percettivi a Google, con particolare attenzione ai prodotti e alle applicazioni XR.

Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da scoperte in compute, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. Il team di Google XR è in prima linea nel prossimo grande salto. la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di nuovi dispositivi. Si tratta di reimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo intorno a noi. Stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali e cuffie intelligenti si accoppiano con utile AI per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversazioni e contestualizzate.

Responsabilità

- Ricerca, sviluppo e fornitura di tecnologie di visione informatica e di apprendimento automatico per piattaforme di realtà aumentata e mista. - Agire come esperto di materia nel prendere modelli di Computer Vision/Machine Learning (CV/ML) dai prototipi di ricerca alla produzione, concentrandosi sull'integrazione di framework mobile, sull'ottimizzazione dei bordi e sulla robustezza dei runtime. - Serve come leader tecnologico attraverso tracce fondamentali delle funzionalità XR, guidando team multidisciplinari di ingegneri software e ricercatori dal numero di telefono del sistema fino al rilascio.

- Collaborare efficacemente con la gestione dei prodotti, UX e programmi, mantenendo l'allineamento proattivo con la leadership esecutiva e stakeholder chiave in tutta l'organizzazione ingegneristica.

Über den Job

Googles Software-Ingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Verbindung, Erforschung und Interaktion mit Informationen und anderen Menschen verändern. Unsere Produkte müssen mit Informationen in großem Maßstab umgehen und weit über die Websuche hinaus reichen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die neue Ideen aus allen Bereichen mitbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteilter Rechentechnik, großformatige Systemgestaltung, Vernetzung und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobil; die Liste geht weiter und wächst täglich.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google entscheidend ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich entwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme im gesamten Ganzen zu übernehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Die Aktivität erstreckt sich über das gesamte Spektrum von der Forschung bis zum Produkt. Das Team besteht aus Experten von Forschungswissenschaftlern und Softwareingenieuren auf dem Gebiet. Das Team bedient bei Google mehrere Wahrnehmungsprodukte mit besonderem Fokus auf XR-Produkte und -Anwendungen.

Seit Jahrzehnten hat die Computerrevolution unsere Welt durch Durchbrüche in Computer, Konnektivität, Mobil und jetzt, AI, neu gestaltet. Das Google XR-Team ist an der Spitze des nächsten großen Sprungs – die Konvergenz von KI und XR. Dies ist mehr als nur neue Geräte – es geht darum, neu zu denken, wie wir mit der Welt um uns herum interagieren. Wir bauen eine Zukunft, in der leichte XR-Geräte wie Smart-Brillen und Headsets mit hilfreicher KI zur Verbesserung der menschlichen Intelligenz paaren, die personalisierte, gesprächs- und kontextbewusste Erfahrungen bietet.

Zuständigkeiten

- Forschung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Computer Vision und Machine Learning Technologien für Augmented und Mixed Reality Plattformen. - Handeln Sie als Experte für die Übernahme von Computer Vision / Machine Learning (CV / ML) Modelle von Forschungs-Prototypen zur Produktion, mit Schwerpunkt auf mobile Framework-Integration, Kantenoptimierung und Laufzeit Robustheit. - Serve als Tech-Führung über kritische XR Feature Tracks, Führung multidisziplinäre Teams von Software-Ingenieuren und Forschern von scoping bis Release.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des occasions de changer d'équipe et de projets à mesure que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, afficher des qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à prendre de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile à bout de main alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Depuis des décennies, la révolution informatique a transformé notre monde en un monde qui a connu des percées dans le calcul, la connectivité, le mobile et maintenant l'IA. L'équipe XR de Google est à l'avant-garde du prochain grand saut – la convergence de l'IA et de l'XR. Il s'agit plus que de nouveaux appareils – il s'agit de rejuger notre interaction avec le monde qui nous entoure.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.

• 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.

• 2 years of experience leading projects and providing technical leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or a related field.

About the job
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.
 Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

• Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.

• Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.

• Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.

• Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.

• Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

- Laurea in Informatica, campo correlato o esperienza pratica equivalente. - 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione. - 3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, analisi e risoluzione dei problemi dei sistemi distribuiti. - 2 anni di esperienza nei progetti leader e nella fornitura di leadership tecnica.

Qualificazioni preferite

- Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Informatica, o un campo correlato.

Riguardo il lavoro

L'ingegneria dell'affidabilità del sito (SRE) combina l'ingegneria del software e dei sistemi per costruire e gestire sistemi su larga scala, distribuiti in modo massiccio, tolleranti i guasti.SRE assicura che i servizi di Google Cloud.sia i nostri sistemi critici interni che quelli esterni.avere affidabilità, tempo di aggiornamento adeguato alle esigenze del cliente e una velocità di miglioramento veloce.

Gran parte dello sviluppo del software si concentra sull'ottimizzazione dei sistemi esistenti, sulla costruzione di infrastrutture ed eliminazione del lavoro attraverso l'automazione. Sul team SRE avrete l'opportunità di gestire le complesse sfide di scala che sono uniche a Google Cloud, utilizzando al contempo le vostre competenze in codifica, algoritmi, analisi della complessità e progettazione di sistemi su larga scala. La cultura della curiosità intellettuale, della risoluzione dei problemi e dell'apertura di SRE è fondamentale per il suo successo. La nostra organizzazione riunisce persone con una vasta gamma di background, esperienze e prospettive.

Li incoraggiamo a collaborare, a pensare in grande e a correre rischi in un ambiente privo di colpe. Promuoviamo l'auto-direzione per lavorare su progetti significativi, mentre ci sforziamo anche di creare un ambiente che fornisca il sostegno e la formazione necessari per imparare e crescere.

Dietro tutto ciò che i nostri utenti vedono online è l'architettura costruita dal team di Technical Infrastructure per mantenerla in funzione. Dallo sviluppo e manutenzione dei nostri data center alla costruzione della prossima generazione di piattaforme Google, rendiamo possibile il portafoglio prodotti di Google. Siamo orgogliosi di essere ingegneri dei nostri ingegneri e amiamo annullare le garanzie facendo le cose separatamente in modo da poterle ricostruire. Manteniamo le nostre reti attive, assicurando ai nostri utenti la migliore e più veloce esperienza possibile.

Responsabilità

- Attivare e migliorare l'intero ciclo di vita dei servizi dalla fase iniziale alla progettazione, fino alla fase di realizzazione, funzionamento e perfezionamento. - Servizi di supporto prima di passare in diretta attraverso attività quali consulenza sulla progettazione di sistemi, sviluppo di piattaforme e quadri software, pianificazione delle capacità e analisi di lancio. - Mantenere i servizi una volta che sono in vita misurando e monitorando la disponibilità, la latenza e la salute generale del sistema. - Scalare i sistemi in modo sostenibile attraverso meccanismi come l'automazione, e evolvere i sistemi spingendo per cambiamenti che migliorano affidabilità e velocità.

- Praticare una risposta sostenibile agli incidenti e post mortem senza colpe.

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) kombiniert Software- und Systemtechnik zum Aufbau und Betrieb von großräumigen, massiv verteilten, fehlertoleranten Systemen. Darüber hinaus behalten SRE's stets die Kapazität und Leistung unserer Systeme im Auge.

Ein Großteil unserer Software-Entwicklung konzentriert sich auf die Optimierung bestehender Systeme, den Aufbau von Infrastruktur und die Beseitigung von Arbeiten durch Automatisierung. Im SRE-Team haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die komplexen Herausforderungen der Größenordnung zu bewältigen, die einzigartig für Google Cloud sind, während Sie Ihre Expertise in der Codierung, Algorithmen, Komplexitätsanalyse und großformatigen Systemdesign nutzen. SREs Kultur der intellektuellen Neugier, Problemlösung und Offenheit ist der Schlüssel zu seinem Erfolg. Unsere Organisation bringt Menschen mit einer Vielzahl von Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen.

Wir ermutigen sie, zusammenzuarbeiten, groß zu denken und Risiken in einem tadellosen Umfeld einzugehen. Wir fördern die Selbstorientierung, um an sinnvollen Projekten zu arbeiten, während wir auch versuchen, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, das die nötige Unterstützung und Mentorschaft bietet, um zu lernen und zu wachsen.

Hinter allem, was unsere Nutzer online sehen, steckt die Architektur, die das Team Technische Infrastruktur aufgebaut hat, um es am Laufen zu halten. Von der Entwicklung und Pflege unserer Rechenzentren bis zum Aufbau der nächsten Generation von Google-Plattformen machen wir das Produktportfolio von Google möglich. Wir sind stolz darauf, Ingenieure unserer Ingenieure zu sein und lieben es, Garantien zu entschärfen, indem wir Dinge auseinandernehmen, damit wir sie wieder aufbauen können.

Zuständigkeiten

- Praxis nachhaltige Reaktion und tadellose postmortems.
